decisions.choice: a new set of laws after the refusal to enter the land
decisions.reason: Chapter 14 ended with the people refusing to go into Canaan and being told that the adults would die in the wilderness (14:28-35). This chapter turns to laws for life in the land, and the speech formula marks the first of three speeches (verses 1, 17, 37).

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("parla", "dit"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit")
decisions.reason: As in the rest of the Pentateuch: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative; Readable uses the passé composé, the tense of spoken and school French. The laws inside the speeches use the future at Literal and Balanced and "devoir" or the imperative at Readable.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for God are written plainly through the chapter.

decisions.choice: Narration plain (L, B), です・ます (R); light respect forms for God's acts ("言われた", R "言われました"); God's speech plain throughout, as in Genesis-Leviticus
decisions.reason: Numbers keeps the register settled for the Pentateuch; noted once in this chunk.

decisions.choice: when you come into the land: the promise still stands
decisions.reason: Right after the people were told that their generation would not enter the land (14:29-30), God speaks of the day when Israel will live there. The promise holds for their children (14:31), and these laws assume it.

decisions.choice: the land of your dwellings: the land where you will settle and live
decisions.reason: The noun means a place where people live or settle. The phrase looks ahead to settled life in Canaan, with fields, vineyards and homes, after the years in the wilderness.

decisions.choice: You will come into the land ...
decisions.reason: Readable makes the time clause a sentence of its own, so that the promise is clear, and verse 3 then begins with the offering.

decisions.choice: God's laws address Israel as "các ngươi" with "phải" / "không được" (L, B) and "phải" / "đừng" (R); the offerer in the third person is "người ấy"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's forms for laws and instructions in the Pentateuch, followed through chapters 15 and 18. Recorded once for these chapters.

decisions.choice: God's laws in 해라체 with "너희": -하라 (L, B), -해야 한다 (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for Exodus to Deuteronomy: God's commands in the plain style, with the imperative at Literal and Balanced and the plain "must" at Readable; third-person law in the written style (-해야 한다). Recorded once for these chapters.

decisions.choice: "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (L, B) and "እስራኤላውያን" (R) with no gender span
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" already includes daughters, so Amharic has no second wording for the setting to offer; the phrase is written plainly through the chapter.

decisions.choice: the sons of Israel: Literal "इस्राएल की सन्तान" in a gender span (setting: "इस्राएल के पुत्रों"); Balanced and Readable "इस्राएली", with no span
decisions.reason: The phrase means the whole people, women as well as men. At Literal Hindi has two wordings, the inclusive "सन्तान" by default and the traditional "पुत्र" with the gender setting. Balanced and Readable say "इस्राएली", which already includes everyone, so the English span there has nothing to change in Hindi. Likewise Hindi pronouns for "the person" (उसका, उसे, वह) do not mark gender, so where the English has a gender span on a pronoun (verses 28, 30, 31) the Hindi has none. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}} (L); "израильтяне" (B, R), with no span
decisions.reason: Following the Pentateuch note, Literal has "дети Израиля" by default with the traditional "сыны Израиля" as the gender alternative; Balanced and Readable say "израильтяне", which already includes men and women, so they need no span where the English has one. Elsewhere in this chapter the English "them / him" spans have no Russian counterpart: "человек" and the pronouns that agree with it already speak of anyone.

decisions.choice: "イスラエルの子ら" (L), "イスラエルの人々" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Both Japanese forms already include women and men, so the English children/sons and Israelites/sons of Israel span is not needed (as in Genesis-Leviticus).

source.text: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־זֶ֔בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֨דֶר֙ א֣וֹ בִנְדָבָ֔ה א֖וֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִן־הַבָּקָ֖ר א֥וֹ מִן־הַצֹּֽאן׃

records.literal_gloss: and you make [an] offering by fire to Yahweh, [a] burnt offering or [a] sacrifice, to fulfill [a] vow or as [a] freewill offering or at your appointed feasts, to make [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh, from the herd or from the flock,

en.L: and you make an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow, or as a freewill offering, or at your appointed feasts, to make an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the herd or from the flock,
en.B: and you present a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the herd or from the flock, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, whether to fulfill a vow, or as a freewill offering, or at your appointed festivals, to make a soothing aroma for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.R: Suppose you bring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a food offering burned on the altar, an animal from your cattle or from your sheep and goats. It may be a burnt offering or another sacrifice. You may bring it to keep a promise, or as a gift you choose to give, or at one of your special festivals. Its smell pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: y {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, holocausto o sacrificio, para cumplir un voto, o como ofrenda voluntaria, o en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} fiestas señaladas, para hacer aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, de la vacada o del rebaño,
es.B: y {{plural_you:presenten|presentéis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda quemada del ganado vacuno o del rebaño, sea holocausto o sacrificio, ya para cumplir un voto, ya como ofrenda voluntaria, ya en {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} fiestas señaladas, como aroma grato para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}},
es.R: Puede ser que {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda quemada en el fuego: un animal de {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} vacas o de {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} ovejas y cabras. Puede ser un holocausto u otro sacrificio. {{plural_you:Pueden|Podéis}} traerlo para cumplir una promesa, o como un regalo que {{plural_you:deciden|decidís}} dar, o en una de {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} fiestas especiales. Su olor es agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: et que vous fassiez une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, un holocauste ou un sacrifice, pour accomplir un vœu, ou en offrande volontaire, ou lors de vos fêtes fixées, pour faire une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, du gros bétail ou du petit bétail,
fr.B: et que vous présentiez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande consumée par le feu, prise dans le gros ou le petit bétail, holocauste ou sacrifice, que ce soit pour accomplir un vœu, en offrande volontaire ou lors de vos fêtes, afin de faire monter une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}},
fr.R: Il peut arriver que vous apportiez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande brûlée sur le feu : un animal pris parmi vos bœufs, ou parmi vos moutons et vos chèvres. Ce peut être un holocauste ou un autre sacrifice. Vous pouvez l’apporter pour tenir une promesse, ou comme un cadeau que vous choisissez de faire, ou pendant une de vos grandes fêtes. Son odeur plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

Harufu yake inampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: và các ngươi dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một của lễ dâng bằng lửa, một của lễ thiêu hay một sinh tế, để trả một lời khấn nguyện, hoặc làm lễ vật tự nguyện, hoặc trong các kỳ lễ đã định của các ngươi, để làm hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, từ bầy bò hay từ bầy chiên dê,
vi.B: và các ngươi dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một của lễ dâng bằng lửa lấy từ bầy bò hay bầy chiên dê, dù là của lễ thiêu hay sinh tế, dù để trả lời khấn nguyện, làm lễ vật tự nguyện, hay trong các kỳ lễ đã định của các ngươi, để làm hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.R: Giả sử các ngươi đem đến cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một của lễ dâng bằng lửa, là một con vật lấy từ bầy bò hay bầy chiên dê của các ngươi. Đó có thể là một của lễ thiêu hay một sinh tế khác. Các ngươi có thể dâng để giữ một lời hứa, hoặc làm một món quà các ngươi tự ý dâng, hoặc trong một kỳ lễ đặc biệt của các ngươi. Mùi hương của nó làm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vui lòng.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물, 곧 번제나 희생 제물을 서원을 갚으려고나 자원 제물로나 너희의 정해진 절기에, 소 떼나 양 떼에서 [가져다가] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새가 되게 바칠 때에는,
ko.B: 서원을 갚으려고, 또는 자원하여, 또는 너희의 정해진 절기에, 소 떼나 양 떼에서 번제나 희생 제물을 골라 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 불로 바치는 제물로 드려 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새가 되게 할 때에는,
ko.R: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제단에서 불로 바치는 제물을 가져온다고 하자. 그것은 너희 소 떼에서나 양과 염소 떼에서 가져온 짐승이다. 번제일 수도 있고 다른 희생 제물일 수도 있다. 서원한 것을 지키려고 가져올 수도 있고, 스스로 원해서 바칠 수도 있고, 정해진 절기에 바칠 수도 있다. 그 냄새는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하시는 향기이다.

pt.L: e vocês fizerem uma oferta queimada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, um holocausto ou um sacrifício, para cumprir um voto, ou como oferta voluntária, ou nas festas fixas de vocês, para fazer um aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, do gado ou do rebanho,
pt.B: e apresentarem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} uma oferta queimada do gado ou do rebanho, seja um holocausto ou um sacrifício, para cumprir um voto, como oferta voluntária ou nas festas fixas de vocês, para produzir um aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}},
pt.R: Suponham que vocês tragam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} uma oferta queimada no fogo, um animal do seu gado ou das suas ovelhas e cabras. Pode ser um holocausto ou outro sacrifício. Vocês podem trazê-lo para cumprir uma promessa, ou como um presente que vocês mesmos decidiram dar, ou numa das suas festas especiais. O cheiro dessa oferta agrada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት፣ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም መሥዋዕት፣ ስእለትን ለመፈጸም ወይም የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ ወይም በበዓሎቻችሁ፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ ለማድረግ ከላም መንጋ ወይም ከበግ መንጋ ስታዘጋጁ፣
am.B: ከላም መንጋ ወይም ከበግና ከፍየል መንጋ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት፣ ማለትም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ሌላ መሥዋዕት፣ ስእለትን ለመፈጸም ወይም የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ ወይም በተወሰኑት በዓሎቻችሁ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ እንዲሆን ስታቀርቡ፣
am.R: ከከብቶቻችሁ ወይም ከበጎቻችሁና ከፍየሎቻችሁ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት ታመጡ ይሆናል። የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ሌላ መሥዋዕት ሊሆን ይችላል። ስእለታችሁን ለመፈጸም፣ ወይም በገዛ ፈቃዳችሁ የምትሰጡት ስጦታ አድርጋችሁ፣ ወይም በልዩ በዓሎቻችሁ ታመጡት ይሆናል። መዓዛውም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ደስ ያሰኛል።

hi.L: और तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंट तैयार करो, होमबलि या मेलबलि, किसी मन्नत को पूरा करने के लिए, या स्वेच्छा की भेंट के रूप में, या अपने नियत पर्वों में, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए सुखद सुगंध बनाने को, गाय-बैलों में से या भेड़-बकरियों में से,
hi.B: और तुम गाय-बैलों में से या भेड़-बकरियों में से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंट चढ़ाओ, होमबलि या कोई और बलि, चाहे मन्नत पूरी करने के लिए, चाहे स्वेच्छा की भेंट के रूप में, चाहे अपने नियत पर्वों में, ताकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए सुखद सुगंध हो,
hi.R: मान लो तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए वेदी पर आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंट लाते हो, अपने गाय-बैलों में से या भेड़-बकरियों में से कोई पशु। वह होमबलि हो सकती है या कोई और बलि। तुम उसे किसी मन्नत को पूरा करने के लिए ला सकते हो, या ऐसे दान के रूप में जो तुम अपनी इच्छा से देते हो, या अपने किसी ख़ास पर्व पर। उसकी सुगंध {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को भाती है।

ru.L: и совершите огненную жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, всесожжение или жертву, во исполнение обета, или как добровольное приношение, или в ваши установленные праздники, чтобы сделать приятный запах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, из крупного скота или из мелкого скота,
ru.B: и принесёте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} огненную жертву из крупного или мелкого скота — всесожжение или жертву, во исполнение обета, или как добровольное приношение, или в ваши установленные праздники, чтобы это был приятный запах для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}},
ru.R: Может быть, вы принесёте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} огненную жертву, сожжённую на жертвеннике, — быка, овцу или козу из вашего стада. Это может быть всесожжение или другая жертва. Вы можете принести её, чтобы исполнить обещание, или как дар, который вы сами решили дать, или в один из ваших особых праздников. Её запах радует {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そしてあなたがたが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に火によるささげ物、すなわち焼き尽くすささげ物またはいけにえを、誓願を果たすため、あるいは自発のささげ物として、あるいはあなたがたの定めの時に、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}へのなだめの香りとするために、牛の群れから、あるいは羊の群れからささげるとき、
ja.B: 牛か羊の群れから、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に火によるささげ物をささげるとき、すなわち、誓願を果たすため、自発のささげ物として、あるいは定めの祭りに、焼き尽くすささげ物やいけにえをささげて、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜ばれる香りとするとき、
ja.R: あなたたちが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に火で焼いてささげる物を持って来るとしよう。それは牛か、羊ややぎの群れから取った動物である。それは焼いてささげるいけにえでも、ほかのいけにえでもよい。誓いを果たすために持って来ることも、自分から進んでささげることも、特別な祭りの時に持って来ることもある。その香りを{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は喜ぶ。

uk.L: і принесете вогняну жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, всепалення чи жертву, щоб виконати обітницю, чи як добровільний дар, чи на ваші визначені свята, щоб зробити приємний запах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} з великої худоби чи з дрібної,
uk.B: і принесете {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} вогняну жертву з великої чи дрібної худоби, всепалення чи жертву, щоб виконати обітницю, як добровільний дар чи на ваші визначені свята, щоб зробити приємний запах для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}},
uk.R: Припустімо, ви приносите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} вогняну жертву, тварину з вашої великої худоби чи з ваших овець і кіз. Це може бути всепалення або інша жертва. Ви можете принести її, щоб виконати обіцянку, як дар, який самі вирішили дати, або на одне з ваших особливих свят. Її запах тішить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: an offering by fire: a gift burned on the altar for the LORD
decisions.reason: The word is related to the word for fire and is used of offerings burned, wholly or in part, on the altar. Leviticus 3:11 calls such an offering "food" for the LORD, a picture of a gift at his table.

decisions.choice: a burnt offering or a sacrifice: the two main kinds of animal offering
decisions.reason: The burnt offering was burned whole on the altar (Leviticus 1). The sacrifice was an offering whose meat was mostly eaten by the worshipers in a shared meal, such as the peace offering of verse 8 (Leviticus 3; 7:16).

decisions.choice: to fulfill a vow, a freewill offering, your appointed feasts: the occasions for these offerings
decisions.reason: A vow offering paid what someone had promised to God, often in return for help asked of him (Genesis 28:20-22). A freewill offering was given unprompted. The appointed feasts are the yearly festivals of Leviticus 23.

decisions.choice: an aroma of soothing: an offering God gladly accepts
decisions.reason: The smoke of the offering is pictured as a smell that calms and pleases God, so that he accepts the one who brings it (Genesis 8:21; Leviticus 1:9).

decisions.choice: food offering
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "food offering", as in Leviticus, and Readable adds "burned on the altar" to say what the word means. Literal keeps "offering by fire".

decisions.choice: your cattle ... your sheep and goats
decisions.reason: Readable names the animals: "the herd" is cattle, and "the flock" is sheep and goats.

decisions.choice: "của lễ dâng bằng lửa"; "của lễ thiêu"; "sinh tế"; "lời khấn nguyện"; "lễ vật tự nguyện"; "kỳ lễ đã định"; "hương thơm làm đẹp lòng"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's and the Vietnamese Leviticus' words for these offerings and occasions. The English Balanced and Readable say "food offering"; Vietnamese keeps the sheet's "của lễ dâng bằng lửa" at every level, which says what the meaning decision says: a gift burned on the altar.

decisions.choice: "불로 바치는 제물" for *ʾishsheh*
decisions.reason: As the term sheet: the plain phrase at every level, so the reader knows what is given; "화제" is the short church word of the older Bibles.

decisions.choice: "향기로운 냄새" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하시는 향기" (R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and the Korean Leviticus 1:9; the meaning decision says it is an offering God gladly accepts, which Readable states.

decisions.choice: a oferta queimada; o holocausto; o sacrifício; aroma agradável (L, B), cheiro que agrada (R)
decisions.reason: The names of the offerings are those of Leviticus 1-7 in Portuguese (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md): the English Balanced says "food offering", but Portuguese keeps "oferta queimada" at every level, with "no fogo" at Readable as Leviticus 1:9 does; the picture of food (m1) is left to the meaning note. "Cumprir um voto" and "oferta voluntária" (L, B) are the words of Leviticus 22:18-21; Readable says "promessa" and "presente", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት" (offering made by fire) for ʾishsheh at every level; "የፈቃድ መሥዋዕት" (freewill offering)
alternatives: "የምግብ መሥዋዕት" (food offering) at Balanced and Readable, as the English
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms and Leviticus set: the Amharic phrase says how the gift reached God, and "food offering" would read oddly in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "मेलबलि" (L) and "कोई और बलि" (B, R) for "a sacrifice" (zevach)
decisions.reason: Zevach beside the burnt offering is the sacrifice that is shared in a meal (m2), so Literal names it "मेलबलि", as the note gives for the shared offerings, while Balanced and Readable follow the English "a sacrifice" with "कोई और बलि".

decisions.choice: "आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंट" for the offering by fire (ishsheh), at Readable too
decisions.reason: The note's term for the food offering, as in Leviticus at every level. Readable adds "वेदी पर", as the English Readable adds "burned on the altar".

decisions.choice: "огненная жертва" for the offering by fire (ishsheh)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note fixes "огненная жертва" at every level: it keeps the Hebrew link with fire, as the English Literal does. Readable adds "сожжённую на жертвеннике" to say what happens to it.

decisions.choice: "приятный запах" (L, B); "её запах радует ГОСПОДА" (R)
decisions.reason: The note gives "приятный запах" at Literal and Balanced and a plain clause at Readable, saying that God gladly accepts the offering (m4).

decisions.choice: 'ishsheh "火によるささげ物" (L, B), "火で焼いてささげる物" (R), where the English B and R say 'food offering'
decisions.reason: Keeps the Leviticus rendering of the term; the Japanese names the offering by its burning, which the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: "вогняна жертва"; "приємний запах" (L, B), "запах тішить" (R)
decisions.reason: As the shared Old Testament terms set for the food offering and the soothing aroma; the formula holds through the offering laws of chapters 15, 18, 28 and 29.

source.text: וְהִקְרִ֛יב הַמַּקְרִ֥יב קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִנְחָה֙ סֹ֣לֶת עִשָּׂר֔וֹן בָּל֕וּל בִּרְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: then will present the [one] presenting his offering to Yahweh [a] grain offering, fine flour [a] tenth, mixed with [the] fourth of the hin [of] oil.

en.L: then the one who presents his offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shall present a grain offering of a tenth [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with a quarter of the hin of oil.
en.B: the one who brings the offering is to present to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a grain offering of {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} of oil.
en.R: Then the person who brings the offering must also give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a grain offering. It is {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} of olive oil.

es.L: entonces el que presente su ofrenda {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} presentará una ofrenda de cereal: un décimo [de efa] de flor de harina mezclada con la cuarta parte del hin de aceite.
es.B: el que traiga la ofrenda presentará {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de flor de harina mezclada con {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} de aceite.
es.R: Entonces la persona que trae la ofrenda tiene que dar también {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} una ofrenda de cereal: {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de la mejor harina mezclada con {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} de aceite de oliva.

fr.L: alors celui qui fera approcher son offrande {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} fera approcher une offrande végétale : un dixième [d’épha] de fleur de farine mêlée au quart du hin d’huile.
fr.B: celui qui apporte l’offrande présentera {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de fleur de farine mêlée à {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} d’huile.
fr.R: Alors celui qui apporte l’offrande doit aussi donner {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} une offrande végétale : {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de la meilleure farine, mélangée avec {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} d’huile d’olive.

sw.L: basi yeye anayemsogezea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka yake atasogeza sadaka ya nafaka, sehemu ya kumi [ya efa] ya unga laini uliochanganywa na robo ya hini ya mafuta.
sw.B: yule anayeleta sadaka atamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka: unga laini {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}}.
sw.R: Kisha mtu anayeleta sadaka lazima pia amletee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya nafaka. Ni unga bora kabisa {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta ya zeituni {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}}.

vi.L: thì người dâng lễ vật của mình cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phải dâng một tế lễ ngũ cốc [gồm] một phần mười [ê-pha] bột mịn trộn với một phần tư hin dầu.
vi.B: thì người đem lễ vật đến phải dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một tế lễ ngũ cốc gồm {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} dầu.
vi.R: Khi ấy người đem lễ vật đến cũng phải dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} một tế lễ ngũ cốc. Đó là {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} dầu ô-liu.

ko.L: 그 제물을 바치는 사람은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 곡식 제물로, 기름 사분의 일 힌을 섞은 고운 가루 십분의 일 [에바]를 바쳐야 한다.
ko.B: 제물을 바치는 사람은 기름 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}을 섞은 고운 가루 {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 에바}}를 곡식 제물로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바쳐야 한다.
ko.R: 그때 제물을 가져오는 사람은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 곡식 제물도 바쳐야 한다. 그것은 올리브기름 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}을 섞은 고운 가루 {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 에바}}이다.

pt.L: então aquele que oferece a sua oferta {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} oferecerá uma oferta de cereal de um décimo [de efa] de flor de farinha, amassada com um quarto de him de azeite.
pt.B: aquele que traz a oferta apresentará {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} uma oferta de cereal de {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|um décimo de efa}} de flor de farinha amassada com {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} de azeite.
pt.R: Então a pessoa que traz a oferta também deve dar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} uma oferta de cereal. Ela deve ser de {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|um décimo de efa}} da melhor farinha misturada com {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} de azeite.

am.L: መባውን {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የሚያቀርበው ሰው የኢን አንድ አራተኛ ዘይት የተለወሰ የ[ኢፍ] አንድ አሥረኛ የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን አድርጎ ያቅርብ።
am.B: መባውን የሚያመጣው ሰው {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን አድርጎ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ያቅርብ፤ ዱቄቱም {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} ዘይት የተለወሰ ይሁን።
am.R: መባውን የሚያመጣው ሰው ደግሞ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የእህል ቁርባን መስጠት አለበት። ይህም {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} የወይራ ዘይት የተለወሰ {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት ነው።

hi.L: तो जो अपना चढ़ावा निकट लाता है, वह {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए अन्नबलि निकट लाए, [एपा का] दसवाँ भाग मैदा, जो हीन के चौथाई भाग तेल से सना हो।
hi.B: तो चढ़ावा लानेवाला {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए अन्नबलि चढ़ाए: {{units:लगभग 2.2 लीटर|एपा का दसवाँ भाग}} मैदा, जो {{units:लगभग 1 लीटर|हीन के चौथाई भाग}} तेल से सना हो।
hi.R: तब चढ़ावा लानेवाले को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए अन्नबलि भी लानी है। वह {{units:लगभग 2.2 लीटर|एपा के दसवें भाग}} मैदे की हो, जिसमें {{units:लगभग 1 लीटर|हीन के चौथाई भाग}} जैतून का तेल मिला हो।

ru.L: то пусть принесёт приносящий приношение своё {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} хлебное приношение — лучшей муки десятую часть [ефы], смешанной с четвертью гина масла.
ru.B: то тот, кто приносит приношение, пусть представит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} хлебное приношение — {{units:около 2,2 литра|десятую часть ефы}} лучшей муки, смешанной с {{units:примерно литром|четвертью гина}} масла.
ru.R: Тогда тот, кто приносит жертву, должен также дать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} хлебное приношение. Это {{units:около 2,2 литра|десятая часть ефы}} лучшей муки, смешанной с {{units:примерно литром|четвертью гина}} оливкового масла.

ja.L: そのとき、自分のささげ物をささげる者は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に穀物のささげ物として、四分の一ヒンの油を混ぜた上等の小麦粉十分の一[エファ]をささげなければならない。
ja.B: ささげ物を携えて来る者は、{{units:約1リットル|四分の一ヒン}}の油を混ぜた上等の小麦粉{{units:約2リットル|十分の一エファ}}を、穀物のささげ物として{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげなければならない。
ja.R: ささげ物を持って来る人は、穀物のささげ物も{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげなさい。それは、いちばん良い小麦粉{{units:約2リットル|十分の一エファ}}に、オリーブ油{{units:約1リットル|四分の一ヒン}}を混ぜたものである。

uk.L: то той, хто приносить свою жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, принесе хлібну жертву: десяту [частину ефи] найкращого борошна, змішаного з четвертою частиною гіна оливи.
uk.B: той, хто приносить жертву, має принести {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} хлібну жертву: {{units:близько 2,2 л|десяту частину ефи}} найкращого борошна, замішаного з {{units:близько 0,9 л|четвертою частиною гіна}} оливи.
uk.R: Тоді людина, яка приносить жертву, мусить дати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} ще й хлібну жертву. Це {{units:близько 2,2 л|десята частина ефи}} найкращого борошна, замішаного з {{units:близько 0,9 л|четвертою частиною гіна}} оливкової олії.

decisions.choice: a grain offering goes with every burnt offering and sacrifice
decisions.reason: The rule in verses 3-12 is that each animal offered is joined by a grain offering and a drink offering, more for a larger animal. Earlier laws ask for them only with some offerings (Exodus 29:40-41; Leviticus 23:13, 18); this law makes them part of every such gift once Israel lives in the land.

decisions.choice: a tenth; a quarter of the hin: about two quarts of flour and a quart of oil
decisions.reason: "A tenth" is a tenth of an ephah, a dry measure of about twenty quarts, so about two quarts of flour. The hin was a liquid measure of about a gallon, so a quarter of a hin is about a quart. Verses 4-5 give the amounts for a lamb or young goat (verse 11).

decisions.choice: fine flour: flour of the best quality
decisions.reason: The word names finely ground flour, the kind used for grain offerings and for fine food (Leviticus 2:1; Genesis 18:6).

decisions.choice: about 2 quarts; about a quart (units setting)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give modern measures, with the ancient ones as the alternative wording. Literal keeps "a tenth [of an ephah]" and "a quarter of the hin". Readable says "olive oil", the oil used for offerings (Exodus 27:20).

decisions.choice: "flor de harina" (L, B); "la mejor harina" (R)
decisions.reason: "Flor de harina" is the Spanish name for the finest flour, as in Genesis 18:6, and is used for every grain offering in Numbers. Readable says "la mejor harina", which says the same thing in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "unos 2 litros" (a tenth of an ephah); "casi un litro" (a quarter of a hin)
alternatives: "la décima parte de un efa", "la cuarta parte de un hin" (units setting)
decisions.reason: Litres from the values used for the whole Pentateuch (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres). For this chapter: two tenths about 4 litres, three tenths about 6.5 litres; a third of a hin about 1.2 litres, half a hin about 2 litres.

decisions.choice: "fleur de farine" (L, B); "la meilleure farine" (R)
decisions.reason: "Fleur de farine" is the French name for the finest flour, as in Genesis 18:6, and is used for every grain offering in Numbers. Readable says "la meilleure farine", which says the same thing in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "environ 2 litres" (a tenth of an ephah); "près d'un litre" (a quarter of a hin)
alternatives: "un dixième d'épha", "un quart de hin" (units setting)
decisions.reason: Litres from the values used for the whole Pentateuch (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres). For this chapter: two tenths about 4 litres, three tenths about 6.5 litres; a third of a hin about 1.2 litres, half a hin about 2 litres.

decisions.choice: "unga laini" (L, B); "unga bora kabisa" (R)
decisions.reason: "Unga laini" is finely ground flour, as in Genesis 18:6, and is used for every grain offering in Numbers. Readable says "unga bora kabisa", the very best flour, which is what the term means (m3).

decisions.choice: "kama lita 2" (a tenth of an ephah); "karibu lita 1" (a quarter of a hin)
alternatives: "sehemu ya kumi ya efa", "robo ya hini" (units setting)
decisions.reason: Litres from the values used for the whole Pentateuch (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres). For this chapter: two tenths about 4 litres, three tenths about 6.5 litres; a third of a hin about 1.2 litres, half a hin about 2 litres. The measure follows the thing measured ("unga laini kama lita 2"), as Swahili usually puts it.

decisions.choice: metric amounts with the original measures as the alternative, as in Exodus and Leviticus (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres)
decisions.reason: The Vietnamese style guide sets metric as the default and the original unit as the alternative; Literal keeps the original unit. The values follow the term sheets (a tenth of an ephah 2.2 litres, a quarter hin 0.9 litre), as the Vietnamese Exodus 29:40.

decisions.choice: Metric by default: {{units:약 2.2리터|십분의 일 에바}}, {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}
alternatives: US measures, as the English default
decisions.reason: As Exodus 29:40 in Korean: the Pentateuch values (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres) in metric, the original measure as the alternative; Literal keeps the ephah and hin. The same values hold for the measures of verses 5-10.

decisions.choice: "곡식 제물"; "고운 가루"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's name for the grain offering, and the Korean Leviticus' word for the fine flour.

decisions.choice: cerca de 2,2 litros; cerca de 1 litro (units setting)
alternatives: um décimo de efa; um quarto de him (as the default)
decisions.reason: For the chapter, as Leviticus 23:13 does in Portuguese: litres by default, with the ancient measures as the alternative, where the English default is quarts. The values follow docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md (efa 22 litros, him 3,7 litros): a tenth, two tenths and three tenths of an ephah are 2,2, 4,4 and 6,6 litros; a quarter, a third and half a hin are about 1, 1,2 and 1,8 litro. Literal keeps "efa" and "him". "Azeite" already means olive oil in Brazil, so Readable needs no word for the English "olive".

decisions.choice: litres by default with the original measure as the alternative: "{{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}}", "{{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}}"; Literal keeps the ephah and hin
decisions.reason: Amharic readers measure in litres, so the metric figure is the default, as in French and Swahili and in the Amharic Leviticus (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres).

decisions.choice: metric measures by default: "लगभग 2.2 लीटर", "लगभग 1 लीटर" (setting: "एपा का दसवाँ भाग", "हीन के चौथाई भाग")
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give metric measures, with the ancient ones as the alternative, where the English gives quarts. A tenth of an ephah is about 2.2 litres and a hin about 3.7 litres, so a quarter hin is about a litre. Literal keeps the ancient measures. The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: {{units:около 2,2 литра|десятую часть ефы}}; {{units:примерно литром|четвертью гина}}
alternatives: US quarts as in the English
decisions.reason: The English converts to US quarts; Russian, as the Pentateuch note says, shows litres by default (an ephah about 22 litres, so a tenth about 2.2; a hin about 3.7 litres, so a quarter about a litre), with the Hebrew measure as the alternative. Literal keeps the Hebrew measures. The same holds for the other amounts in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "лучшая мука" for the fine flour
decisions.reason: The point is flour of the best quality (m3); "лучшая мука" says so in current Russian, where "пшеничная мука" names only the grain.

decisions.choice: units spans in litres by default ("約2リットル", "約1リットル"), the ephah and hin as the alternative; Literal keeps the Hebrew measures
decisions.reason: Japanese readers use metric measures, not the US quarts of the English default (style guide section 7). Third hin "約1.2リットル", half hin "約1.8リットル" in this chapter.

decisions.choice: litres by default (ephah 22 litres, hin 3.7 litres), the Hebrew measures as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the shared terms set, the Ukrainian units setting gives metric measures with a decimal comma, rounded as the English rounds, and keeps the ephah and the hin as the alternative; Literal keeps the Hebrew units.

source.text: וְיַ֤יִן לַנֶּ֨סֶךְ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ית הַהִ֔ין תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עַל־הָעֹלָ֖ה א֣וֹ לַזָּ֑בַח לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And wine for the drink offering, [the] fourth of the hin, you will prepare with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for the one lamb.

en.L: And wine for the drink offering, a quarter of the hin, you shall prepare with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
en.B: With the burnt offering or the sacrifice you are also to prepare {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} of wine for the drink offering, for each lamb.
en.R: For each lamb, also bring {{units:about a quart|a quarter of a hin}} of wine as a drink offering, to be poured out at the altar.

es.L: Y vino para la libación, la cuarta parte del hin, prepararás con el holocausto o para el sacrificio, por cada cordero.
es.B: Con el holocausto o el sacrificio prepararás también {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} de vino para la libación, por cada cordero.
es.R: Por cada cordero, trae también {{units:casi un litro|la cuarta parte de un hin}} de vino como ofrenda de vino, que se derrama junto al altar.

fr.L: Et du vin pour la libation, le quart du hin, tu [le] prépareras avec l’holocauste ou pour le sacrifice, pour chaque agneau.
fr.B: Avec l’holocauste ou le sacrifice, tu prépareras aussi {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} de vin pour la libation, pour chaque agneau.
fr.R: Pour chaque agneau, apporte aussi {{units:près d’un litre|un quart de hin}} de vin comme offrande de vin, que l’on verse près de l’autel.

sw.L: Na divai kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kinywaji, robo ya hini, utaiandaa pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa au kwa ajili ya dhabihu, kwa kila mwanakondoo.
sw.B: Pamoja na sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, utaandaa pia divai {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}} kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kinywaji, kwa kila mwanakondoo.
sw.R: Kwa kila mwanakondoo, lete pia divai {{units:karibu lita 1|robo ya hini}} kuwa sadaka ya kinywaji, itakayomiminwa madhabahuni.

vi.L: Và rượu cho lễ quán, một phần tư hin, ngươi phải chuẩn bị cùng với của lễ thiêu hay cho sinh tế, cho mỗi con chiên con.
vi.B: Cùng với của lễ thiêu hay sinh tế, ngươi cũng phải chuẩn bị {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} rượu làm lễ quán cho mỗi con chiên con.
vi.R: Với mỗi con chiên con, cũng phải dâng {{units:khoảng 0,9 lít|một phần tư hin}} rượu làm lễ quán, rưới ra nơi bàn thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 번제나 희생 제물에 [곁들여], 어린 숫양 한 마리마다 부어 드리는 제물로 포도주 사분의 일 힌을 준비하여라.
ko.B: 또 번제나 희생 제물에 곁들여, 어린 양 한 마리마다 부어 드리는 제물로 포도주 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}을 준비하여라.
ko.R: 또 어린 양 한 마리마다 포도주 {{units:약 0.9리터|사분의 일 힌}}을 가져와서, 부어 드리는 제물로 제단에 부어야 한다.

pt.L: E vinho para a oferta de bebida, um quarto de him, prepararás com o holocausto ou para o sacrifício, para cada cordeiro.
pt.B: Com o holocausto ou o sacrifício prepararás também {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} de vinho para a oferta de bebida, para cada cordeiro.
pt.R: Para cada cordeiro, traz também {{units:cerca de 1 litro|um quarto de him}} de vinho como oferta de bebida, para ser derramado junto ao altar.

am.L: ለአንዱም ጠቦት ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ወይም ከመሥዋዕቱ ጋር ለመጠጥ ቁርባን የኢን አንድ አራተኛ የወይን ጠጅ ታዘጋጃለህ።
am.B: ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ወይም ከመሥዋዕቱ ጋር ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቁርባን አዘጋጁ።
am.R: ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት በመሠዊያው ላይ የሚፈስ {{units:1 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ አራተኛ}} የወይን ጠጅ የመጠጥ ቁርባን አድርጋችሁ አምጡ።

hi.L: और अर्घ के लिए दाखमधु, हीन का चौथाई भाग, तुम होमबलि के साथ या बलि के लिए, हर एक मेम्ने के लिए तैयार करो।
hi.B: होमबलि या बलि के साथ तुम हर एक मेम्ने के लिए अर्घ के रूप में {{units:लगभग 1 लीटर|हीन का चौथाई भाग}} दाखमधु भी तैयार करो।
hi.R: हर एक मेम्ने के साथ अर्घ के रूप में {{units:लगभग 1 लीटर|हीन का चौथाई भाग}} दाखमधु भी लाना, जो वेदी के पास उंडेला जाए।

ru.L: И вина для возлияния, четверть гина, приготовь при всесожжении или для жертвы, на одного ягнёнка.
ru.B: Вместе со всесожжением или жертвой приготовь также {{units:около литра|четверть гина}} вина для возлияния на каждого ягнёнка.
ru.R: На каждого ягнёнка принеси ещё {{units:около литра|четверть гина}} вина для возлияния: его выливают у жертвенника.

ja.L: また、注ぎの供え物のためのぶどう酒四分の一ヒンを、焼き尽くすささげ物、またはいけにえに添えて、小羊一頭ごとに用意しなければならない。
ja.B: 焼き尽くすささげ物やいけにえには、小羊一頭ごとに、注ぎの供え物として、ぶどう酒{{units:約1リットル|四分の一ヒン}}も用意しなさい。
ja.R: 小羊一頭ごとに、ぶどう酒{{units:約1リットル|四分の一ヒン}}も、注ぎの供え物として持って来なさい。それは祭壇で注ぐためのものである。

uk.L: І вина для жертви виливання четверту частину гіна приготуєш при всепаленні чи для жертви на кожне ягня.
uk.B: До всепалення чи жертви ти маєш також приготувати {{units:близько 0,9 л|четверту частину гіна}} вина для жертви виливання на кожне ягня.
uk.R: На кожне ягня принось також {{units:близько 0,9 л|четверту частину гіна}} вина як жертву виливання, яку виливають біля жертовника.

decisions.choice: the drink offering: wine poured out with the sacrifice
decisions.reason: The drink offering was wine poured out at the altar along with a burnt offering or other sacrifice (Exodus 29:40-41; Leviticus 23:13). Verses 5, 7 and 10 set its amount for each kind of animal.

decisions.choice: for the one lamb: for each lamb
decisions.reason: "The one" here has the sense "each": the amounts are for every animal offered, as verse 12 says. The command now addresses each worshiper as "you" (singular).

decisions.choice: to be poured out at the altar
decisions.reason: Readable adds what a drink offering is, since the term alone does not say what was done with the wine.

decisions.choice: "la libación" (L, B); "ofrenda de vino, que se derrama junto al altar" (R)
decisions.reason: "Libación" is the Spanish word for an offering poured out, as in Genesis 35:14. Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: singular "tú" forms ("prepararás", "trae") in verses 5-10
alternatives: plural forms with the plural-you setting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from plural "you" (verse 3) to singular for each worshiper (m2), and Spanish shows the difference. The plural returns in verse 12.

decisions.choice: "la libation" (L, B); "offrande de vin, que l'on verse près de l'autel" (R)
decisions.reason: "Libation" is the French word for an offering poured out, as in Genesis 35:14. Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "tu" in verses 5-10
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from plural "you" (verse 3) to singular for each worshiper (m2), and French shows the difference. "Vous" returns in verse 12.

decisions.choice: "sadaka ya kinywaji"
decisions.reason: The term used in Genesis 35:14. Readable adds "itakayomiminwa madhabahuni", as the English Readable explains what was done with the wine. The singular verbs ("utaandaa", "lete") follow the Hebrew's turn to one worshiper (m2).

decisions.choice: "lễ quán" for the drink offering
decisions.reason: The word of the Vietnamese Exodus 29:40-41; Readable adds that it is poured out, as the English Readable does. The Hebrew "you" turns singular here and in verse 6, which Literal and Balanced keep with "ngươi".

decisions.choice: "부어 드리는 제물" for the drink offering
decisions.reason: As the Korean Exodus 29:40-41; "전제" is the short church word.

decisions.choice: tu (prepararás, traz) in verses 5-10
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew turns from "you" plural to "you" singular, each worshiper (m2), and back to the plural in verse 12. Portuguese follows it, as Leviticus does for laws given to one person: "tu" with the future at Literal and Balanced, the imperative ("traz") at Readable.

decisions.choice: singular "ታዘጋጃለህ" (you, singular, shall prepare) at Literal in verses 5-10 where the Hebrew turns to the singular; plural at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Amharic marks the number of "you"; Literal follows the Hebrew's change between the plural and the singular, which addresses each worshipper, while the other levels keep one plural address through the law.

decisions.choice: "अर्घ" for the drink offering (nesekh)
decisions.reason: "अर्घ" is the Hindi word for a liquid poured out as an offering, which is what the drink offering was (m1). Readable adds that it was poured out at the altar, as the English Readable does. The same through Numbers.

decisions.choice: "возлияние" for the drink offering
decisions.reason: "Возлияние" is the established Russian word for wine poured out with a sacrifice (m1) and is used for it throughout the Pentateuch; Readable adds what is done with it.

source.text: א֤וֹ לָאַ֨יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַהִֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: Or for the ram you will prepare [a] grain offering, fine flour two tenths, mixed with oil, [the] third of the hin.

en.L: Or for a ram you shall prepare a grain offering of two tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with a third of the hin of oil.
en.B: For a ram, prepare a grain offering of {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about 1 1/4 quarts|a third of a hin}} of oil.
en.R: If you offer a ram, bring a grain offering of {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about 1 1/4 quarts|a third of a hin}} of olive oil.

es.L: O para un carnero prepararás una ofrenda de cereal: dos décimos [de efa] de flor de harina mezclada con la tercera parte del hin de aceite.
es.B: Para un carnero prepararás una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 4 litros|dos décimas partes de un efa}} de flor de harina mezclada con {{units:unos 1,2 litros|la tercera parte de un hin}} de aceite.
es.R: Si ofreces un carnero, trae una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 4 litros|dos décimas partes de un efa}} de la mejor harina mezclada con {{units:unos 1,2 litros|la tercera parte de un hin}} de aceite de oliva.

fr.L: Ou pour un bélier, tu prépareras une offrande végétale : deux dixièmes [d’épha] de fleur de farine mêlée au tiers du hin d’huile.
fr.B: Pour un bélier, tu prépareras une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 4 litres|deux dixièmes d’épha}} de fleur de farine mêlée à {{units:environ 1,2 litre|un tiers de hin}} d’huile.
fr.R: Si tu offres un bélier, apporte une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 4 litres|deux dixièmes d’épha}} de la meilleure farine, mélangée avec {{units:environ 1,2 litre|un tiers de hin}} d’huile d’olive.

sw.L: Au kwa ajili ya kondoo dume utaandaa sadaka ya nafaka, sehemu mbili za kumi [za efa] za unga laini uliochanganywa na theluthi ya hini ya mafuta.
sw.B: Kwa kondoo dume, utaandaa sadaka ya nafaka: unga laini {{units:kama lita 4|sehemu mbili za kumi za efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta {{units:kama lita 1.2|theluthi ya hini}}.
sw.R: Ukimtoa kondoo dume, lete sadaka ya nafaka: unga bora kabisa {{units:kama lita 4|sehemu mbili za kumi za efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta ya zeituni {{units:kama lita 1.2|theluthi ya hini}}.

vi.L: Hoặc cho một con chiên đực, ngươi phải chuẩn bị một tế lễ ngũ cốc [gồm] hai phần mười [ê-pha] bột mịn trộn với một phần ba hin dầu.
vi.B: Nếu là một con chiên đực, ngươi phải chuẩn bị một tế lễ ngũ cốc gồm {{units:khoảng 4,4 lít|hai phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 1,2 lít|một phần ba hin}} dầu.
vi.R: Nếu dâng một con chiên đực, phải đem theo một tế lễ ngũ cốc gồm {{units:khoảng 4,4 lít|hai phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 1,2 lít|một phần ba hin}} dầu ô-liu.

ko.L: 또는 숫양에는 기름 삼분의 일 힌을 섞은 고운 가루 십분의 이 [에바]로 곡식 제물을 준비하여라.
ko.B: 숫양에는 기름 {{units:약 1.2리터|삼분의 일 힌}}을 섞은 고운 가루 {{units:약 4.4리터|십분의 이 에바}}로 곡식 제물을 준비하여라.
ko.R: 숫양을 바칠 때에는 올리브기름 {{units:약 1.2리터|삼분의 일 힌}}을 섞은 고운 가루 {{units:약 4.4리터|십분의 이 에바}}를 곡식 제물로 가져와야 한다.

pt.L: Ou, para um carneiro, prepararás uma oferta de cereal de dois décimos [de efa] de flor de farinha amassada com um terço de him de azeite.
pt.B: Para um carneiro, prepararás uma oferta de cereal de {{units:cerca de 4,4 litros|dois décimos de efa}} de flor de farinha amassada com {{units:cerca de 1,2 litro|um terço de him}} de azeite.
pt.R: Se ofereceres um carneiro, traz uma oferta de cereal de {{units:cerca de 4,4 litros|dois décimos de efa}} da melhor farinha misturada com {{units:cerca de 1,2 litro|um terço de him}} de azeite.

am.L: ወይም ለአውራ በግ የኢን አንድ ሦስተኛ ዘይት የተለወሰ የ[ኢፍ] ሁለት አሥረኛ የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን ታዘጋጃለህ።
am.B: ለአውራ በግ ደግሞ {{units:4.4 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ ሁለት አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን አዘጋጁ፤ ዱቄቱም {{units:1.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ ሦስተኛ}} ዘይት የተለወሰ ይሁን።
am.R: አውራ በግ ብታቀርቡ {{units:1.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ ሦስተኛ}} የወይራ ዘይት የተለወሰ {{units:4.4 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ ሁለት አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን አምጡ።

hi.L: या मेढ़े के लिए तुम अन्नबलि तैयार करो, [एपा के] दो दसवें भाग मैदा, जो हीन के तीसरे भाग तेल से सना हो।
hi.B: मेढ़े के लिए {{units:लगभग 4.4 लीटर|एपा के दो दसवें भाग}} मैदे की अन्नबलि तैयार करो, जो {{units:लगभग 1.2 लीटर|हीन के तीसरे भाग}} तेल से सना हो।
hi.R: यदि तुम मेढ़ा चढ़ाओ, तो {{units:लगभग 4.4 लीटर|एपा के दो दसवें भाग}} मैदे की अन्नबलि लाना, जिसमें {{units:लगभग 1.2 लीटर|हीन के तीसरे भाग}} जैतून का तेल मिला हो।

ru.L: Или для барана приготовь хлебное приношение — лучшей муки две десятых [ефы], смешанной с маслом, третью гина.
ru.B: Для барана приготовь хлебное приношение — {{units:около 4,4 литра|две десятых ефы}} лучшей муки, смешанной с {{units:примерно 1,2 литра|третью гина}} масла.
ru.R: Если ты приносишь барана, принеси хлебное приношение: {{units:около 4,4 литра|две десятых ефы}} лучшей муки, смешанной с {{units:примерно 1,2 литра|третью гина}} оливкового масла.

ja.L: あるいは雄羊のためには、三分の一ヒンの油を混ぜた上等の小麦粉十分の二[エファ]の穀物のささげ物を用意しなければならない。
ja.B: 雄羊の場合には、{{units:約1.2リットル|三分の一ヒン}}の油を混ぜた上等の小麦粉{{units:約4リットル|十分の二エファ}}を、穀物のささげ物として用意しなさい。
ja.R: 雄羊をささげるときは、いちばん良い小麦粉{{units:約4リットル|十分の二エファ}}にオリーブ油{{units:約1.2リットル|三分の一ヒン}}を混ぜて、穀物のささげ物として持って来なさい。

uk.L: Або на барана приготуєш хлібну жертву: дві десяті [ефи] найкращого борошна, змішаного з третиною гіна оливи.
uk.B: На барана приготуй хлібну жертву: {{units:близько 4,4 л|дві десяті ефи}} найкращого борошна, замішаного з {{units:близько 1,2 л|третиною гіна}} оливи.
uk.R: Якщо приносиш барана, принеси хлібну жертву: {{units:близько 4,4 л|дві десяті ефи}} найкращого борошна, замішаного з {{units:близько 1,2 л|третиною гіна}} оливкової олії.

decisions.choice: two tenths; a third of the hin: more for a larger animal
decisions.reason: The amounts grow with the animal: for a lamb a tenth of an ephah of flour and a quarter of a hin of oil and of wine (verses 4-5), for a ram two tenths and a third (verses 6-7), for a bull three tenths and a half (verses 9-10). Two tenths of an ephah is about four quarts, and a third of a hin about one and a quarter quarts. The same scale is used for the daily and festival offerings (28:12-14).

decisions.choice: about 4 quarts; about 1 1/4 quarts (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in verse 4, Balanced and Readable give modern measures, with the ancient ones as the alternative.

source.text: וְיַ֥יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And wine for the drink offering, [the] third of the hin, you will present, [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: And wine for the drink offering, a third of the hin, you shall present, an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Also present {{units:about 1 1/4 quarts|a third of a hin}} of wine for the drink offering, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Also bring {{units:about 1 1/4 quarts|a third of a hin}} of wine as a drink offering. Its smell pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y vino para la libación, la tercera parte del hin, presentarás, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Presentarás también {{units:unos 1,2 litros|la tercera parte de un hin}} de vino para la libación, como aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Trae también {{units:unos 1,2 litros|la tercera parte de un hin}} de vino para derramarlo como ofrenda. Su olor es agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et du vin pour la libation, le tiers du hin, tu [le] feras approcher, odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tu présenteras aussi {{units:environ 1,2 litre|un tiers de hin}} de vin pour la libation, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Apporte aussi {{units:environ 1,2 litre|un tiers de hin}} de vin, à verser en offrande. Son odeur plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na divai kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kinywaji, theluthi ya hini, utaisogeza, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Utatoa pia divai {{units:kama lita 1.2|theluthi ya hini}} kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kinywaji, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lete pia divai {{units:kama lita 1.2|theluthi ya hini}} kuwa sadaka ya kinywaji. Harufu yake inampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và rượu cho lễ quán, một phần ba hin, ngươi phải dâng, làm hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ngươi cũng phải dâng {{units:khoảng 1,2 lít|một phần ba hin}} rượu làm lễ quán, làm hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Cũng phải dâng {{units:khoảng 1,2 lít|một phần ba hin}} rượu làm lễ quán. Mùi hương của nó làm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vui lòng.

ko.L: 그리고 부어 드리는 제물로 포도주 삼분의 일 힌을 바쳐, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새가 되게 하여라.
ko.B: 또 부어 드리는 제물로 포도주 {{units:약 1.2리터|삼분의 일 힌}}을 바쳐라. 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새이다.
ko.R: 또 포도주 {{units:약 1.2리터|삼분의 일 힌}}을 부어 드리는 제물로 가져와야 한다. 그 냄새는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하시는 향기이다.

pt.L: E vinho para a oferta de bebida, um terço de him, oferecerás, aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Oferecerás também {{units:cerca de 1,2 litro|um terço de him}} de vinho para a oferta de bebida, como aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Traz também {{units:cerca de 1,2 litro|um terço de him}} de vinho como oferta de bebida. O cheiro dessa oferta agrada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ለመጠጥ ቁርባንም የኢን አንድ ሦስተኛ የወይን ጠጅ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ አድርገህ ታቀርባለህ።
am.B: ለመጠጥ ቁርባንም {{units:1.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ ሦስተኛ}} የወይን ጠጅ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ አድርጋችሁ አቅርቡ።
am.R: እንዲሁም {{units:1.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን አንድ ሦስተኛ}} የወይን ጠጅ የመጠጥ ቁርባን አድርጋችሁ አምጡ። መዓዛውም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ደስ ያሰኛል።

hi.L: और अर्घ के लिए दाखमधु, हीन का तीसरा भाग, तुम निकट लाओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए सुखद सुगंध।
hi.B: अर्घ के लिए {{units:लगभग 1.2 लीटर|हीन का तीसरा भाग}} दाखमधु भी चढ़ाओ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए सुखद सुगंध।
hi.R: अर्घ के रूप में {{units:लगभग 1.2 लीटर|हीन का तीसरा भाग}} दाखमधु भी लाना। उसकी सुगंध {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को भाती है।

ru.L: И вина для возлияния, треть гина, принеси — приятный запах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Принеси также {{units:около 1,2 литра|треть гина}} вина для возлияния — приятный запах для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Принеси ещё {{units:около 1,2 литра|треть гина}} вина для возлияния. Его запах радует {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: また、注ぎの供え物のためのぶどう酒三分の一ヒンを、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}へのなだめの香りとしてささげなければならない。
ja.B: また、注ぎの供え物として、ぶどう酒{{units:約1.2リットル|三分の一ヒン}}をささげなさい。これは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜ばれる香りである。
ja.R: ぶどう酒{{units:約1.2リットル|三分の一ヒン}}も、注ぎの供え物として持って来なさい。その香りを{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は喜ぶ。

uk.L: І вина для жертви виливання третину гіна принесеш, приємний запах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Принеси також {{units:близько 1,2 л|третину гіна}} вина для жертви виливання, приємний запах для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Принеси також {{units:близько 1,2 л|третину гіна}} вина як жертву виливання. Її запах тішить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: an aroma of soothing: as in verse 3
decisions.reason: The offering for the ram, with its grain and wine, is a gift the LORD accepts (verse 3).

source.text: וְכִֽי־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן־בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־זָ֑בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֥דֶר אֽוֹ־שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And when you prepare [a] son of [the] herd [as a] burnt offering or [a] sacrifice, to fulfill [a] vow or peace offerings to Yahweh,

en.L: And when you prepare a young [bull] of the herd as a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow, or as peace offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.B: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering, or as a sacrifice to fulfill a vow, or as a peace offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.R: Suppose you bring a young bull as a burnt offering, or as a sacrifice to keep a promise, or as a peace offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y cuando prepares un joven [toro] de la vacada como holocausto o sacrificio, para cumplir un voto, o como sacrificios de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}},
es.B: Cuando prepares un novillo como holocausto, o como sacrificio para cumplir un voto, o como sacrificio de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}},
es.R: Puede ser que traigas un novillo como holocausto, o como sacrificio para cumplir una promesa, o como sacrificio de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et quand tu prépareras un jeune [taureau] du gros bétail en holocauste ou en sacrifice, pour accomplir un vœu, ou en sacrifices de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}},
fr.B: Quand tu prépareras un jeune taureau en holocauste, ou en sacrifice pour accomplir un vœu, ou en sacrifice de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}},
fr.R: Il peut arriver que tu apportes un jeune taureau en holocauste, ou en sacrifice pour tenir une promesse, ou en sacrifice de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na utakapoandaa [fahali] mchanga wa kundi la ng'ombe kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa au dhabihu, ili kutimiza nadhiri, au kuwa sadaka za amani kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.B: Utakapoandaa fahali mchanga kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, au dhabihu ya kutimiza nadhiri, au sadaka ya amani kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.R: Huenda ukamletea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} fahali mchanga kuwa sadaka ya kuteketezwa, au dhabihu ya kutimiza ahadi, au sadaka ya amani.

vi.L: Và khi ngươi chuẩn bị một con [bò] tơ trong bầy làm của lễ thiêu hay sinh tế, để trả một lời khấn nguyện, hoặc làm tế lễ bình an cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.B: Khi ngươi chuẩn bị một con bò tơ làm của lễ thiêu, hoặc làm sinh tế để trả lời khấn nguyện, hoặc làm tế lễ bình an dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.R: Giả sử ngươi dâng một con bò tơ làm của lễ thiêu, hoặc làm sinh tế để giữ một lời hứa, hoặc làm tế lễ bình an dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 네가 소 떼의 어린 [수소를] 번제로나, 서원을 갚는 희생 제물로나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 화목제로 준비할 때에는,
ko.B: 네가 어린 수소를 번제로, 또는 서원을 갚는 희생 제물로, 또는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드리는 화목제로 준비할 때에는,
ko.R: 너희가 어린 수소를 번제로 바치거나, 서원한 것을 지키려고 희생 제물로 바치거나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 화목제로 바친다고 하자.

pt.L: E quando preparares um novilho do gado como holocausto ou sacrifício, para cumprir um voto, ou como sacrifícios de comunhão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}},
pt.B: Quando preparares um novilho como holocausto, ou como sacrifício para cumprir um voto, ou como sacrifício de comunhão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}},
pt.R: Pode ser que tragas um novilho como holocausto, ou como sacrifício para cumprir uma promessa, ou como sacrifício de comunhão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ከላም መንጋ ወይፈንን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ስእለትን ለመፈጸም መሥዋዕት ወይም የኅብረት መሥዋዕት አድርገህ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስታዘጋጅ፣
am.B: ወይፈንን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ስእለትን ለመፈጸም የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት ወይም የኅብረት መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስታዘጋጁ፣
am.R: ወይፈንን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ስእለትን ለመፈጸም መሥዋዕት ወይም የኅብረት መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ታመጡ ይሆናል።

hi.L: और जब तुम गाय-बैलों में से एक बछड़े को होमबलि या बलि के रूप में तैयार करो, किसी मन्नत को पूरा करने के लिए, या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए मेलबलि के रूप में,
hi.B: जब तुम एक बछड़े को होमबलि के रूप में, या मन्नत पूरी करने की बलि के रूप में, या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए मेलबलि के रूप में तैयार करो,
hi.R: मान लो तुम एक बछड़ा होमबलि के रूप में लाते हो, या किसी मन्नत को पूरा करने की बलि के रूप में, या {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए मेलबलि के रूप में।

ru.L: И когда приготовишь сына крупного скота во всесожжение или в жертву, во исполнение обета или в мирную жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}},
ru.B: Когда приготовишь молодого быка во всесожжение, или в жертву во исполнение обета, или в мирную жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}},
ru.R: Может быть, ты принесёшь молодого быка во всесожжение, или в жертву, чтобы исполнить обещание, или в мирную жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: また、あなたが牛の群れの若い[雄牛]を、焼き尽くすささげ物として、あるいは誓願を果たすためのいけにえとして、あるいは和解のいけにえとして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に用意するとき、
ja.B: 若い雄牛を、焼き尽くすささげ物として、あるいは誓願を果たすためのいけにえとして、あるいは交わりのいけにえとして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に用意するときは、
ja.R: 若い雄牛を、焼いてささげるいけにえとして、または誓いを果たすためのいけにえとして、または交わりのいけにえとして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげるとしよう。

uk.L: А коли приготуєш молодого [бика] з великої худоби на всепалення чи жертву, щоб виконати обітницю, чи як мирні жертви {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}},
uk.B: Коли приготуєш молодого бика на всепалення, чи як жертву, щоб виконати обітницю, чи як мирну жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}},
uk.R: Припустімо, ти приносиш молодого бика на всепалення, чи як жертву, щоб виконати обіцянку, чи як мирну жертву {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: a son of the herd: a young bull
decisions.reason: "Son of" with the name of a herd or kind means one young animal of it. Verse 9 repeats the phrase, and verse 11 calls the same animal an ox or bull.

decisions.choice: peace offerings: sacrifices shared in a meal
decisions.reason: The peace offering was a sacrifice of which some parts were burned, a share went to the priest, and the rest was eaten by the worshipers (Leviticus 3; 7:11-21). A vow sacrifice was one kind of it (Leviticus 7:16).

decisions.choice: a young [bull]
decisions.reason: Literal brackets "bull", since the Hebrew says only "a young one of the herd".

decisions.choice: "tế lễ bình an" for peace offerings
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word, as in Leviticus 3.

decisions.choice: "화목제" for the peace offerings
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word for the *shelamim*, as Exodus and Leviticus give it in Korean.

decisions.choice: "गाय-बैलों में से एक बछड़ा" (a young one of the herd)
decisions.reason: Hindi "बछड़ा" already means a young bull, so Literal needs no bracket where the English supplies "[bull]"; "गाय-बैलों में से" keeps the Hebrew "of the herd".

decisions.choice: "сына крупного скота" (L); "молодого быка" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "son of the herd", as the English Literal does in its own way; the other levels say what it means, a young bull (m1).

source.text: וְהִקְרִ֤יב עַל־בֶּן־הַבָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן חֲצִ֥י הַהִֽין׃

records.literal_gloss: then he will present with the son of the herd [a] grain offering, fine flour three tenths, mixed with oil, half of the hin.

en.L: then he shall present with the young [bull] of the herd a grain offering of three tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with half of the hin of oil.
en.B: then with the young bull a grain offering is to be presented, {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about 2 quarts|half a hin}} of oil.
en.R: Along with the bull, bring a grain offering of {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} of fine flour mixed with {{units:about 2 quarts|half a hin}} of olive oil.

es.L: entonces presentará con el joven [toro] de la vacada una ofrenda de cereal: tres décimos [de efa] de flor de harina mezclada con la mitad del hin de aceite.
es.B: entonces, junto con el novillo, se presentará una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 6,5 litros|tres décimas partes de un efa}} de flor de harina mezclada con {{units:unos 2 litros|medio hin}} de aceite.
es.R: Junto con el novillo, trae una ofrenda de cereal de {{units:unos 6,5 litros|tres décimas partes de un efa}} de la mejor harina mezclada con {{units:unos 2 litros|medio hin}} de aceite de oliva.

fr.L: alors il fera approcher avec le jeune [taureau] du gros bétail une offrande végétale : trois dixièmes [d’épha] de fleur de farine mêlée à la moitié du hin d’huile.
fr.B: alors, avec le jeune taureau, on présentera une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 6,5 litres|trois dixièmes d’épha}} de fleur de farine mêlée à {{units:environ 2 litres|un demi-hin}} d’huile.
fr.R: Avec le taureau, apporte une offrande végétale de {{units:environ 6,5 litres|trois dixièmes d’épha}} de la meilleure farine, mélangée avec {{units:environ 2 litres|un demi-hin}} d’huile d’olive.

sw.L: basi atasogeza pamoja na [fahali] mchanga wa kundi la ng'ombe sadaka ya nafaka, sehemu tatu za kumi [za efa] za unga laini uliochanganywa na nusu ya hini ya mafuta.
sw.B: basi pamoja na fahali huyo mchanga itatolewa sadaka ya nafaka: unga laini {{units:kama lita 6.5|sehemu tatu za kumi za efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta {{units:kama lita 2|nusu ya hini}}.
sw.R: Pamoja na fahali, lete sadaka ya nafaka: unga bora kabisa {{units:kama lita 6.5|sehemu tatu za kumi za efa}} uliochanganywa na mafuta ya zeituni {{units:kama lita 2|nusu ya hini}}.

vi.L: thì cùng với con bò tơ, người ấy phải dâng một tế lễ ngũ cốc [gồm] ba phần mười [ê-pha] bột mịn trộn với nửa hin dầu.
vi.B: thì cùng với con bò tơ phải dâng một tế lễ ngũ cốc gồm {{units:khoảng 6,6 lít|ba phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 1,8 lít|nửa hin}} dầu.
vi.R: Cùng với con bò, phải đem đến một tế lễ ngũ cốc gồm {{units:khoảng 6,6 lít|ba phần mười ê-pha}} bột mịn trộn với {{units:khoảng 1,8 lít|nửa hin}} dầu ô-liu.

ko.L: 그는 그 어린 수소와 함께 기름 반 힌을 섞은 고운 가루 십분의 삼 [에바]로 곡식 제물을 바쳐야 한다.
ko.B: 그 어린 수소와 함께 기름 {{units:약 1.8리터|반 힌}}을 섞은 고운 가루 {{units:약 6.6리터|십분의 삼 에바}}를 곡식 제물로 바쳐야 한다.
ko.R: 그 수소와 함께 올리브기름 {{units:약 1.8리터|반 힌}}을 섞은 고운 가루 {{units:약 6.6리터|십분의 삼 에바}}를 곡식 제물로 가져와야 한다.

pt.L: então [ele] oferecerá com o novilho uma oferta de cereal de três décimos [de efa] de flor de farinha amassada com meio him de azeite.
pt.B: com o novilho será apresentada uma oferta de cereal de {{units:cerca de 6,6 litros|três décimos de efa}} de flor de farinha amassada com {{units:cerca de 1,8 litro|meio him}} de azeite.
pt.R: Junto com o novilho, traz uma oferta de cereal de {{units:cerca de 6,6 litros|três décimos de efa}} da melhor farinha misturada com {{units:cerca de 1,8 litro|meio him}} de azeite.

am.L: ከወይፈኑ ጋር የኢን ግማሽ ዘይት የተለወሰ የ[ኢፍ] ሦስት አሥረኛ የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን ያቅርብ።
am.B: ከወይፈኑ ጋር {{units:6.6 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ ሦስት አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን ይቅረብ፤ ዱቄቱም {{units:1.9 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን ግማሽ}} ዘይት የተለወሰ ይሁን።
am.R: ከወይፈኑ ጋር {{units:1.9 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን ግማሽ}} የወይራ ዘይት የተለወሰ {{units:6.6 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ ሦስት አሥረኛ}} የላመ ዱቄት የእህል ቁርባን አምጡ።

hi.L: तो वह बछड़े के साथ अन्नबलि निकट लाए, [एपा के] तीन दसवें भाग मैदा, जो आधे हीन तेल से सना हो।
hi.B: तो बछड़े के साथ अन्नबलि चढ़ाई जाए: {{units:लगभग 6.6 लीटर|एपा के तीन दसवें भाग}} मैदा, जो {{units:लगभग 1.8 लीटर|आधे हीन}} तेल से सना हो।
hi.R: बछड़े के साथ {{units:लगभग 6.6 लीटर|एपा के तीन दसवें भाग}} मैदे की अन्नबलि भी लाना, जिसमें {{units:लगभग 1.8 लीटर|आधा हीन}} जैतून का तेल मिला हो।

ru.L: то пусть принесёт он с сыном крупного скота хлебное приношение — лучшей муки три десятых [ефы], смешанной с маслом, половиной гина.
ru.B: то вместе с молодым быком пусть будет принесено хлебное приношение — {{units:около 6,6 литра|три десятых ефы}} лучшей муки, смешанной с {{units:примерно 1,8 литра|половиной гина}} масла.
ru.R: Вместе с быком принеси хлебное приношение: {{units:около 6,6 литра|три десятых ефы}} лучшей муки, смешанной с {{units:примерно 1,8 литра|половиной гина}} оливкового масла.

ja.L: そのとき彼は、その若い[雄牛]に添えて、半ヒンの油を混ぜた上等の小麦粉十分の三[エファ]の穀物のささげ物をささげなければならない。
ja.B: その若い雄牛に添えて、{{units:約1.8リットル|半ヒン}}の油を混ぜた上等の小麦粉{{units:約6リットル|十分の三エファ}}を、穀物のささげ物としてささげなければならない。
ja.R: その雄牛と一緒に、いちばん良い小麦粉{{units:約6リットル|十分の三エファ}}にオリーブ油{{units:約1.8リットル|半ヒン}}を混ぜて、穀物のささげ物として持って来なさい。

uk.L: то він принесе разом із молодим [биком] з великої худоби хлібну жертву: три десяті [ефи] найкращого борошна, змішаного з половиною гіна оливи.
uk.B: то разом із молодим биком треба принести хлібну жертву: {{units:близько 6,6 л|три десяті ефи}} найкращого борошна, замішаного з {{units:близько 1,8 л|половиною гіна}} оливи.
uk.R: Разом із биком принеси хлібну жертву: {{units:близько 6,6 л|три десяті ефи}} найкращого борошна, замішаного з {{units:близько 1,8 л|половиною гіна}} оливкової олії.

decisions.choice: he will present: the worshiper who brings the bull
decisions.reason: "He" is the one who brings the offering, as in verse 4. The command moves between "you" and "he" for the same person.

decisions.choice: three tenths; half of the hin: the amounts for a bull
decisions.reason: Three tenths of an ephah is about six quarts of flour, and half a hin about two quarts of oil (see verse 6).

decisions.choice: about 6 quarts; about 2 quarts (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in verse 4. Balanced puts the verb in the passive so that the worshiper does not change from "you" to "he" in the middle of the sentence.

source.text: וְיַ֛יִן תַּקְרִ֥יב לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ חֲצִ֣י הַהִ֑ין אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And wine you will present for the drink offering, half of the hin, [an] offering by fire, [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: And wine you shall present for the drink offering, half of the hin, an offering by fire, an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: And present {{units:about 2 quarts|half a hin}} of wine for the drink offering. It is a food offering, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Also bring {{units:about 2 quarts|half a hin}} of wine as a drink offering. It is a food offering, and its smell pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y vino presentarás para la libación, la mitad del hin, ofrenda quemada, aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Presentarás también {{units:unos 2 litros|medio hin}} de vino para la libación. Es una ofrenda quemada, de aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Trae también {{units:unos 2 litros|medio hin}} de vino para derramarlo como ofrenda. Es una ofrenda quemada en el fuego, y su olor es agradable para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et du vin, tu [en] feras approcher pour la libation, la moitié du hin, offrande consumée par le feu, odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tu présenteras aussi {{units:environ 2 litres|un demi-hin}} de vin pour la libation. C’est une offrande consumée par le feu, une odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Apporte aussi {{units:environ 2 litres|un demi-hin}} de vin, à verser en offrande. C’est une offrande brûlée sur le feu, et son odeur plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na divai utaisogeza kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kinywaji, nusu ya hini, sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Utatoa pia divai {{units:kama lita 2|nusu ya hini}} kwa ajili ya sadaka ya kinywaji. Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto, harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lete pia divai {{units:kama lita 2|nusu ya hini}} kuwa sadaka ya kinywaji. Ni sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto, na harufu yake inampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải dâng rượu cho lễ quán, nửa hin, [làm] một của lễ dâng bằng lửa, hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ngươi cũng phải dâng {{units:khoảng 1,8 lít|nửa hin}} rượu làm lễ quán. Đó là của lễ dâng bằng lửa, hương thơm làm đẹp lòng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Cũng phải dâng {{units:khoảng 1,8 lít|nửa hin}} rượu làm lễ quán. Đó là của lễ dâng bằng lửa, và mùi hương của nó làm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vui lòng.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 부어 드리는 제물로 포도주 반 힌을 바쳐라. [이것은] 불로 바치는 제물이요, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새이다.
ko.B: 또 부어 드리는 제물로 포도주 {{units:약 1.8리터|반 힌}}을 바쳐라. 이것은 불로 바치는 제물이며, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 향기로운 냄새이다.
ko.R: 또 포도주 {{units:약 1.8리터|반 힌}}을 부어 드리는 제물로 가져와야 한다. 이것은 불로 바치는 제물이고, 그 냄새는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 기뻐하시는 향기이다.

pt.L: E vinho oferecerás para a oferta de bebida, meio him, oferta queimada, aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: E oferecerás {{units:cerca de 1,8 litro|meio him}} de vinho para a oferta de bebida. É uma oferta queimada, de aroma agradável {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Traz também {{units:cerca de 1,8 litro|meio him}} de vinho como oferta de bebida. É uma oferta queimada no fogo, e o seu cheiro agrada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

am.L: ለመጠጥ ቁርባንም የኢን ግማሽ የወይን ጠጅ ታቀርባለህ፤ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት፣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ [ነው]።
am.B: ለመጠጥ ቁርባንም {{units:1.9 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን ግማሽ}} የወይን ጠጅ አቅርቡ። ይህ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት፣ ደስ የሚያሰኝ መዓዛ ነው።
am.R: እንዲሁም {{units:1.9 ሊትር ያህል|የኢን ግማሽ}} የወይን ጠጅ የመጠጥ ቁርባን አድርጋችሁ አምጡ። ይህ በእሳት የሚቀርብ መሥዋዕት ነው፤ መዓዛውም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ደስ ያሰኛል።

hi.L: और अर्घ के लिए दाखमधु, आधा हीन, तुम निकट लाओ, आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंट, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए सुखद सुगंध।
hi.B: और अर्घ के लिए {{units:लगभग 1.8 लीटर|आधा हीन}} दाखमधु चढ़ाओ। यह आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंट है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए सुखद सुगंध।
hi.R: अर्घ के रूप में {{units:लगभग 1.8 लीटर|आधा हीन}} दाखमधु भी लाना। यह आग में चढ़ाई गई भेंट है, और इसकी सुगंध {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को भाती है।

ru.L: И вина принеси для возлияния половину гина — огненная жертва, приятный запах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: И принеси {{units:около 1,8 литра|половину гина}} вина для возлияния. Это огненная жертва, приятный запах для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Принеси ещё {{units:около 1,8 литра|половину гина}} вина для возлияния. Это огненная жертва, и её запах радует {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.

ja.L: また、注ぎの供え物としてぶどう酒半ヒンをささげなければならない。[これは]火によるささげ物、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}へのなだめの香りである。
ja.B: また、注ぎの供え物として、ぶどう酒{{units:約1.8リットル|半ヒン}}をささげなさい。これは火によるささげ物、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に喜ばれる香りである。
ja.R: ぶどう酒{{units:約1.8リットル|半ヒン}}も、注ぎの供え物として持って来なさい。これは火で焼いてささげる物であり、その香りを{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は喜ぶ。

uk.L: І вина принесеш для жертви виливання половину гіна, вогняну жертву, приємний запах {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: І принеси {{units:близько 1,8 л|половину гіна}} вина для жертви виливання. Це вогняна жертва, приємний запах для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Принеси також {{units:близько 1,8 л|половину гіна}} вина як жертву виливання. Це вогняна жертва, і її запах тішить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: an offering by fire: the whole gift with the bull
decisions.reason: Wine was poured out, not burned, so "an offering by fire" probably sums up the bull with its grain and wine as one gift on the altar fire. It could also be meant of the wine itself, poured out at the altar where the fire burned.

source.text: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה לַשּׁוֹר֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד א֖וֹ לָאַ֣יִל הָאֶחָ֑ד אֽוֹ־לַשֶּׂ֥ה בַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים א֥וֹ בָעִזִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus it will be done for the one ox or for the one ram or for the sheep among the lambs or among the goats.

en.L: Thus it shall be done for each ox, or for each ram, or for a young one of the flock, of the lambs or of the goats.
en.B: This is what is to be done for each bull or ram, and for each lamb or young goat.
en.R: Do this for every bull, every ram, and every lamb or young goat.

es.L: Así se hará con cada buey, o con cada carnero, o con cada res del rebaño, de los corderos o de las cabras.
es.B: Así se hará con cada toro o carnero, y con cada cordero o cabrito.
es.R: Haz esto con cada toro, cada carnero y cada cordero o cabrito.

fr.L: Ainsi on fera pour chaque bœuf, ou pour chaque bélier, ou pour chaque bête du petit bétail, des agneaux ou des chèvres.
fr.B: C’est ainsi qu’on procédera pour chaque taureau ou bélier, et pour chaque agneau ou chevreau.
fr.R: Fais cela pour chaque taureau, chaque bélier, et chaque agneau ou chevreau.

sw.L: Hivyo ndivyo itakavyofanywa kwa kila ng'ombe, au kwa kila kondoo dume, au kwa kila mnyama wa kundi, wa wanakondoo au wa mbuzi.
sw.B: Ndivyo itakavyofanywa kwa kila fahali au kondoo dume, na kwa kila mwanakondoo au mwanambuzi.
sw.R: Fanya hivi kwa kila fahali, kila kondoo dume, na kila mwanakondoo au mwanambuzi.

vi.L: Phải làm như vậy cho mỗi con bò đực, hoặc cho mỗi con chiên đực, hoặc cho một con non trong bầy, chiên con hay dê con.
vi.B: Đó là điều phải làm cho mỗi con bò đực hay chiên đực, và cho mỗi con chiên con hay dê con.
vi.R: Hãy làm như vậy cho mỗi con bò đực, mỗi con chiên đực, và mỗi con chiên con hay dê con.

ko.L: 수소 한 마리나 숫양 한 마리나, 어린 양이나 어린 염소 가운데 한 마리에도 이와 같이 해야 한다.
ko.B: 수소나 숫양 한 마리마다, 어린 양이나 어린 염소 한 마리마다 이렇게 해야 한다.
ko.R: 수소든 숫양이든, 어린 양이든 어린 염소든, 한 마리마다 이렇게 해야 한다.

pt.L: Assim se fará para cada boi, ou para cada carneiro, ou para cada cria do rebanho, dos cordeiros ou dos cabritos.
pt.B: Isso é o que se fará para cada novilho ou carneiro, e para cada cordeiro ou cabrito.
pt.R: Façam isso para cada novilho, cada carneiro e cada cordeiro ou cabrito.

am.L: ለአንዱ በሬ ወይም ለአንዱ አውራ በግ ወይም ከጠቦቶች ወይም ከፍየሎች ለአንዱ እንዲሁ ይደረግ።
am.B: ለእያንዳንዱ በሬ ወይም አውራ በግ፣ ለእያንዳንዱም ጠቦት ወይም የፍየል ግልገል እንዲሁ ይደረግ።
am.R: ለእያንዳንዱ በሬ፣ ለእያንዳንዱ አውራ በግ፣ ለእያንዳንዱም ጠቦት ወይም የፍየል ግልገል እንዲሁ አድርጉ።

hi.L: हर एक बैल के लिए, या हर एक मेढ़े के लिए, या भेड़-बकरियों के बच्चे के लिए, मेम्नों में से या बकरियों में से, ऐसा ही किया जाए।
hi.B: हर एक बछड़े या मेढ़े के लिए, और हर एक मेम्ने या बकरी के बच्चे के लिए ऐसा ही किया जाए।
hi.R: हर बछड़े, हर मेढ़े और हर मेम्ने या बकरी के बच्चे के लिए ऐसा ही करना।

ru.L: Так пусть делается для одного быка, или для одного барана, или для ягнёнка из овец или из коз.
ru.B: Так нужно делать для каждого быка или барана, для каждого ягнёнка или козлёнка.
ru.R: Делай так для каждого быка, каждого барана и каждого ягнёнка или козлёнка.

ja.L: このように、牛一頭ごとに、雄羊一頭ごとに、また群れの一頭ごとに、小羊であれやぎであれ、行われなければならない。
ja.B: 雄牛であれ雄羊であれ、小羊であれ子やぎであれ、一頭ごとにこのようにしなければならない。
ja.R: 雄牛でも、雄羊でも、小羊でも子やぎでも、一頭ごとにこのようにしなさい。

uk.L: Так нехай робиться для кожного вола, чи для кожного барана, чи для ягняти з дрібної худоби, з овець чи з кіз.
uk.B: Так треба робити для кожного бика чи барана і для кожного ягняти чи козеняти.
uk.R: Роби так для кожного бика, кожного барана і кожного ягняти чи козеняти.

decisions.choice: ox: a bull of the herd
decisions.reason: The word names a single head of cattle. It is the same animal as "the young one of the herd" in verses 8-9.

decisions.choice: a young one of the flock, of the lambs or of the goats: a sheep or a goat
decisions.reason: The word means one animal of the flock, either sheep or goat. So the amounts for a lamb in verses 4-5 also apply to a young goat.

decisions.choice: bull
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "bull" for the ox, so that it is clearly the animal of verses 8-10. Literal keeps "ox".

source.text: כַּמִּסְפָּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָאֶחָ֖ד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: According to the number which you prepare, thus you will do for each according to their number.

en.L: According to the number that you prepare, so you shall do for each one, according to their number.
en.B: However many animals you prepare, do this for each one of them.
en.R: Do this for each animal you bring, however many there are.

es.L: Conforme al número que {{plural_you:preparen|preparéis}}, así {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} con cada uno, conforme a su número.
es.B: Sea cual sea el número de animales que {{plural_you:preparen|preparéis}}, {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} esto con cada uno de ellos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} esto con cada animal que {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}}, sin importar cuántos sean.

fr.L: Selon le nombre que vous préparerez, ainsi vous ferez pour chacun, selon leur nombre.
fr.B: Quel que soit le nombre d’animaux que vous préparerez, vous ferez ainsi pour chacun d’eux.
fr.R: Faites cela pour chaque animal que vous apportez, quel que soit leur nombre.

sw.L: Kwa kadiri ya hesabu mtakayoandaa, ndivyo mtakavyofanya kwa kila mmoja, kwa kadiri ya hesabu yao.
sw.B: Hata mkiandaa wanyama wangapi, mtafanya hivi kwa kila mmoja wao.
sw.R: Fanyeni hivi kwa kila mnyama mnayemleta, hata wawe wangapi.

vi.L: Theo số [con vật] các ngươi chuẩn bị, các ngươi phải làm như vậy cho mỗi con, theo số của chúng.
vi.B: Các ngươi chuẩn bị bao nhiêu con vật thì phải làm như vậy cho từng con một.
vi.R: Hãy làm như vậy cho mỗi con vật các ngươi đem đến, dù nhiều bao nhiêu đi nữa.

ko.L: 너희가 준비하는 수대로, 그 수에 따라 한 마리마다 이와 같이 하여라.
ko.B: 너희가 짐승을 몇 마리 준비하든지, 한 마리마다 이렇게 하여라.
ko.R: 너희가 가져오는 짐승이 몇 마리이든, 한 마리마다 이렇게 해야 한다.

pt.L: Segundo o número que vocês prepararem, assim farão para cada um, segundo o número deles.
pt.B: Seja qual for o número de animais que vocês prepararem, farão isso para cada um deles.
pt.R: Façam isso para cada animal que vocês trouxerem, não importa quantos sejam.

am.L: እንደምታዘጋጁት ቁጥር፣ እንደ ቁጥራቸው ለእያንዳንዱ እንዲሁ ታደርጋላችሁ።
am.B: የምታዘጋጇቸው እንስሶች ስንትም ቢሆኑ ለእያንዳንዳቸው እንዲሁ አድርጉ።
am.R: ምንም ያህል ብዙ ቢሆኑ ለምታመጡት ለእያንዳንዱ እንስሳ እንዲሁ አድርጉ።

hi.L: जितनी [संख्या] तुम तैयार करो, उसके अनुसार हर एक के लिए ऐसा ही करना, उनकी संख्या के अनुसार।
hi.B: तुम जितने भी पशु तैयार करो, उनमें से हर एक के लिए ऐसा ही करना।
hi.R: तुम जितने भी पशु लाओ, हर एक के लिए ऐसा ही करना।

ru.L: По числу, которое приготовите, так делайте для каждого по числу их.
ru.B: Сколько бы животных вы ни приготовили, делайте так для каждого из них.
ru.R: Делай так для каждого животного, которое приносишь, сколько бы их ни было.

ja.L: あなたがたが用意する数に従って、その数に従って、一頭ごとにこのように行わなければならない。
ja.B: 用意する動物が何頭であっても、その一頭一頭にこのようにしなさい。
ja.R: 何頭持って来ても、一頭ごとにこのようにしなさい。

uk.L: За числом, яке приготуєте, так зробите для кожного, за їхнім числом.
uk.B: Скільки б тварин ви не приготували, робіть так для кожної з них.
uk.R: Роби так для кожної тварини, яку приносиш, скільки б їх не було.

decisions.choice: according to their number: the measures are for each animal
decisions.reason: If several animals are offered at once, each one has its own grain offering and drink offering.

decisions.choice: animals
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what is counted, the animals offered.

source.text: כָּל־הָאֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה־כָּ֖כָה אֶת־אֵ֑לֶּה לְהַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Every native will do thus these [things], in presenting [an] offering by fire, [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh.

en.L: Every native shall do these [things] thus, in presenting an offering by fire, an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Everyone who is native-born is to do these things in this way when presenting a food offering, a soothing aroma to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
