decisions.reason: The third speech of the chapter (see verse 1), on tassels that help Israel remember the commandments, follows the story of a man who broke one of them.

source.text: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: Speak to [the] sons of Israel and say to them, and they will make for themselves tassel[s] on [the] corners of their garments to their generations, and they will put on [the] tassel of the corner [a] cord of blue.

en.L: "Speak to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel and say to them [that] they shall make for themselves tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and they shall put on the tassel of each corner a cord of blue.
en.B: "Speak to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Tell them that in every generation they are to make tassels for the corners of their clothing and fasten a blue cord to the tassel at each corner.
en.R: "Tell the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} that for all time to come they must make tassels for the corners of their clothes. On the tassel at each corner they must tie a blue cord.

es.L: «Habla a los hijos de Israel y diles que se hagan borlas en las esquinas de sus vestidos por sus generaciones, y que pongan en la borla de cada esquina un cordón azul.
es.B: «Habla a los israelitas. Diles que, en cada generación, se hagan borlas para las esquinas de su ropa y que aten un cordón azul a la borla de cada esquina.
es.R: «Diles a los israelitas que, por todo el tiempo que venga, tienen que hacerse borlas para las esquinas de su ropa. En la borla de cada esquina tienen que atar un cordón azul.

fr.L: « Parle aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël et dis-leur qu’ils se fassent des houppes aux coins de leurs vêtements au long de leurs générations, et qu’ils mettent sur la houppe de chaque coin un cordon bleu.
fr.B: « Parle aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Dis-leur que, de génération en génération, ils devront se faire des houppes aux coins de leurs vêtements et attacher un cordon bleu à la houppe de chaque coin.
fr.R: « Dis aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} que, pour toujours, ils doivent se faire des houppes aux coins de leurs vêtements. À la houppe de chaque coin, ils doivent attacher un cordon bleu.

sw.L: "Sema na wana wa Israeli, uwaambie wajifanyie vishada katika pembe za mavazi yao katika vizazi vyao, na waweke juu ya kishada cha kila pembe uzi wa rangi ya samawati.
sw.B: "Sema na Waisraeli. Waambie kwamba katika kila kizazi wajifanyie vishada katika pembe za mavazi yao, na kufunga uzi wa samawati kwenye kishada cha kila pembe.
sw.R: "Waambie Waisraeli kwamba kwa wakati wote ujao lazima wajifanyie vishada katika pembe za nguo zao. Kwenye kishada cha kila pembe lazima wafunge uzi wa samawati.

vi.L: "Hãy nói với con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên và bảo họ [rằng] qua các thế hệ của họ, họ phải làm cho mình những cái tua ở các góc áo mình, và trên cái tua ở mỗi góc, họ phải gắn một sợi dây màu xanh dương.
vi.B: "Hãy nói với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Hãy bảo họ rằng qua mọi thế hệ, họ phải làm những cái tua ở các góc áo mình và buộc một sợi dây màu xanh dương vào cái tua ở mỗi góc.
vi.R: "Hãy bảo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên rằng mãi về sau, họ phải làm những cái tua ở các góc áo của mình. Trên cái tua ở mỗi góc, họ phải buộc một sợi dây màu xanh dương.

ko.L: "이스라엘 자손에게 말하여 그들에게 일러라. 그들은 대대로 자기 옷자락 귀퉁이에 술을 만들고, 그 귀퉁이의 술에 청색 끈을 달아야 한다.
ko.B: "이스라엘 백성에게 말하여 일러라. 그들은 대대로 옷자락 귀퉁이에 술을 만들어 달고, 귀퉁이마다 그 술에 청색 끈을 매야 한다.
ko.R: "이스라엘 사람들에게 일러 주어라. 그들은 앞으로 영원히 옷의 귀퉁이에 술을 만들어 달아야 한다. 귀퉁이마다 달린 술에는 청색 끈을 매야 한다.

pt.L: "Fala aos filhos de Israel e dize-lhes [que] façam para si borlas nas pontas das suas roupas pelas gerações deles, e ponham sobre a borla de cada ponta um cordão azul.
pt.B: "Fala aos israelitas. Dize-lhes que, em todas as gerações, eles devem fazer borlas nas pontas das suas roupas e prender um cordão azul à borla de cada ponta.
pt.R: "Diz aos israelitas que, por todo o tempo que virá, eles devem fazer borlas nas pontas das roupas. Na borla de cada ponta devem amarrar um cordão azul.

am.L: «ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ በትውልዶቻቸውም ሁሉ በልብሶቻቸው ማዕዘኖች ላይ ለራሳቸው ዘርፍ እንዲያደርጉ፣ በእያንዳንዱም ማዕዘን ዘርፍ ላይ ሰማያዊ ፈትል እንዲያኖሩ ንገራቸው።
am.B: «ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር። በየትውልዳቸው በልብሶቻቸው ማዕዘኖች ላይ ዘርፍ እንዲያደርጉ፣ በእያንዳንዱም ማዕዘን ዘርፍ ላይ ሰማያዊ ፈትል እንዲያስሩ ንገራቸው።
am.R: «በልብሶቻቸው ማዕዘኖች ላይ ለዘመናት ሁሉ ዘርፍ ማድረግ እንዳለባቸው ለእስራኤላውያን ንገራቸው። በእያንዳንዱም ማዕዘን ባለው ዘርፍ ላይ ሰማያዊ ፈትል ማሰር አለባቸው።

hi.L: "{{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} से बात करो और उनसे कहो कि वे अपनी पीढ़ी-पीढ़ी में अपने वस्त्रों के कोनों पर झब्बे बनाएँ, और हर कोने के झब्बे पर नीले रंग की एक डोरी लगाएँ।
hi.B: "इस्राएलियों से बात करो। उनसे कहो कि वे हर पीढ़ी में अपने कपड़ों के कोनों पर झब्बे बनाएँ, और हर कोने के झब्बे में नीली डोरी बाँधें।
hi.R: "इस्राएलियों से कहो कि आनेवाले सारे समय में उन्हें अपने कपड़ों के कोनों पर झब्बे बनाने हैं। हर कोने के झब्बे पर उन्हें एक नीली डोरी बाँधनी है।

ru.L: «Говори {{gender:детям Израиля|сынам Израиля}} и скажи им, чтобы делали себе кисти на углах одежд своих в роды свои и чтобы прикрепляли к кисти на углу шнур синий.
ru.B: «Говори с израильтянами. Скажи им, чтобы во всех поколениях они делали кисти на углах своей одежды и прикрепляли к кисти на каждом углу синий шнур.
ru.R: «Скажи израильтянам, что на все времена они должны делать кисти на углах своей одежды. К кисти на каждом углу они должны привязывать синий шнур.

ja.L: 「イスラエルの子らに語り、彼らに言いなさい。彼らは代々にわたって、自分たちの衣服の隅に房を作り、各隅の房に青色のひもを付けなければならない。
ja.B: 「イスラエルの人々に語りなさい。代々にわたって衣服の隅に房を作り、それぞれの隅の房に青いひもを付けるよう、彼らに告げなさい。
ja.R: 「イスラエルの人々に告げなさい。彼らはこれから先いつまでも、服の隅に房を作らなければならない。それぞれの隅の房には、青いひもを結びつけなければならない。

uk.L: «Говори до {{gender:нащадків Ізраїля|синів Ізраїля}} і скажи їм, [щоб] вони зробили собі китиці на краях своїх одежин у своїх поколіннях, і щоб поклали на китицю кожного краю шнур синій.
uk.B: «Говори до ізраїльтян. Скажи їм, щоб у кожному поколінні вони робили китиці на краях свого одягу і прикріплювали синій шнур до китиці на кожному краї.
uk.R: «Скажи ізраїльтянам, щоб завжди, і тепер, і в майбутньому, вони робили китиці на краях свого одягу. На китицю кожного краю вони мусять привʼязати синій шнур.

decisions.choice: tassels: twisted threads hanging from the garment
decisions.reason: The word means a fringe or tassel; it is also used of a lock of hair (Ezekiel 8:3). The singular is used for the tassels as a group, one at each corner.

decisions.choice: the corners of their garments: the outer cloak
decisions.reason: The everyday outer garment was a large piece of cloth with four corners, worn as a cloak and used as a blanket at night (Exodus 22:25-26; Deuteronomy 22:12).

decisions.choice: blue: a costly blue or violet dye
decisions.reason: The dye was made from sea snails and was very expensive. It colored the curtains of the tabernacle and the high priest's robe (Exodus 26:1; 28:31). A cord of it on everyone's clothes marked every Israelite as belonging to the holy God (verse 40).

decisions.choice: tell them that ... they are to make
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the command into reported speech. The direct words of the LORD to the people begin in verse 39, where the Hebrew turns to "you".

decisions.choice: "borlas"; "un cordón azul"
decisions.reason: "Borla" is a tassel of threads hanging from one point, one at each corner (m1); "flecos" would be a fringe along the whole edge. The dye was blue-violet (m3); Spanish says "azul", as the English says "blue".

decisions.choice: "des houppes"; "un cordon bleu"
decisions.reason: "Houppe" is a tassel of threads hanging from one point, one at each corner (m1); "franges" would be a fringe along the whole edge. The dye was blue-violet (m3). French says "bleu", as the English does and as Exodus does for the same dye, including "un cordon bleu" on the breastpiece (Exodus 28:28, 37); a reviewer may prefer "violet" or "bleu-violet", since "un cordon bleu" is also a fixed phrase for a fine cook.

decisions.choice: "vishada" (sg. "kishada"); "uzi wa samawati"
decisions.reason: "Kishada" is a tassel or bunch of threads, one at each corner (m1); "pindo" is a hem or fringe along the edge. The dye was blue-violet (m3); Swahili says "samawati" (blue), as the English says "blue"; "zambarau" would read as purple.

decisions.choice: "tua" for tassels; "màu xanh dương" for blue; "góc áo" for the corners of the garment
decisions.reason: Twisted threads hanging from the cloak (meaning decision); "xanh dương" is the colour word settled for the same dye in the Vietnamese Exodus, though the meaning decision allows blue or violet.

decisions.choice: "술" for the tassels; "청색 끈" for the cord of blue
decisions.reason: "술" is the Korean word for twisted threads hanging from a garment (meaning decision); "청색" is the blue of the Exodus yarns in Korean, so the costly dye is heard as the same colour.

decisions.choice: borlas; um cordão azul
decisions.reason: The word means twisted threads hanging from the corner of a cloak (m1), so Portuguese says "borla", the tuft or tassel, at every level, as the English says "tassels"; "franjas", the word of older Portuguese Bibles, suggests a fringe along the whole edge. "Azul" is the costly blue-violet dye of the tabernacle (m3), as the English says "blue".

decisions.choice: "ዘርፍ" (tassel, fringe) on "የልብሶቻቸው ማዕዘኖች" (the corners of their garments), with "ሰማያዊ ፈትል" (a blue cord)
decisions.reason: The tassels hang from the corners of the outer cloak; "ሰማያዊ" and "ፈትል" are the words Exodus used for the blue yarn of the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: "झब्बा" for the tassel (tsitsit)
decisions.reason: "झब्बा" is a bunch of threads hanging down, which is what the tassel was (m1); "झालर" would be a fringe along the whole edge.

decisions.choice: "кисти" for the tassels; "синий шнур" for the cord of blue
decisions.reason: "Кисти" names the twisted threads hanging from the garment (m1); the dye was a costly blue or violet (m3), and "синий" is the plain Russian colour word, where "голубой" would suggest a pale sky-blue.

decisions.choice: tsitsit "房" at every level; blue "青色の" (L), "青い" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "房" is the ordinary word for a tassel and is Jōyō; a transliteration would need explaining.

decisions.choice: "китиці"; "синій шнур"
decisions.reason: "Китиці" names the twisted tassels hanging from the cloak's corners; "синій" is the plain colour word used for the costly dye in the tent chapters.

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תָתֻ֜רוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be for you as [a] tassel, and you will see it and remember all [the] commandments of Yahweh and do them, and not you will go about after your heart and after your eyes, after which you [are] prostituting,

en.L: 'And it shall be a tassel for you, and you shall look at it and remember all the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and do them, and you shall not go about after your heart and after your eyes, after which you prostitute yourselves,
en.B: 'Whenever you see this tassel, it will remind you of all the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, so that you do them and do not wander after your own heart and your own eyes, following them in unfaithfulness,
en.R: 'When you look at the tassel, you will remember all {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s commands and obey them. You will not just follow whatever your heart wants and your eyes see. Following them is like being unfaithful in a marriage.

es.L: “Y será para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una borla, y la {{plural_you:mirarán|miraréis}} y {{plural_you:se acordarán|os acordaréis}} de todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los {{plural_you:cumplirán|cumpliréis}}, y no {{plural_you:andarán|andaréis}} explorando tras {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón y tras {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ojos, tras los cuales {{plural_you:se prostituyen|os prostituís}},
es.B: “Cada vez que {{plural_you:vean|veáis}} esta borla, {{plural_you:les|os}} recordará todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que los {{plural_you:cumplan|cumpláis}} y no {{plural_you:anden|andéis}} errantes tras {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} propio corazón y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} propios ojos, siguiéndolos con infidelidad,
es.R: “Cuando {{plural_you:miren|miréis}} la borla, {{plural_you:se acordarán|os acordaréis}} de todos los mandatos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y los {{plural_you:obedecerán|obedeceréis}}. No {{plural_you:seguirán|seguiréis}} simplemente lo que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón quiera y lo que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} ojos vean. Seguir eso es como ser infiel en un matrimonio.

fr.L: “Et ce sera pour vous une houppe, et vous la regarderez et vous vous souviendrez de tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et vous les pratiquerez, et vous n’irez pas explorer à la suite de votre cœur et à la suite de vos yeux, derrière lesquels vous vous prostituez,
fr.B: “Chaque fois que vous verrez cette houppe, elle vous rappellera tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour que vous les mettiez en pratique et que vous n’erriez pas au gré de votre propre cœur et de vos propres yeux, en les suivant dans l’infidélité,
fr.R: “Quand vous regarderez la houppe, vous vous souviendrez de tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et vous y obéirez. Vous ne suivrez pas simplement ce que votre cœur désire et ce que vos yeux voient. Les suivre, c’est comme être infidèle dans un mariage.

sw.L: 'Nacho kitakuwa kishada kwenu, nanyi mtakitazama na kuzikumbuka amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuzitenda, wala hamtazunguka kufuata moyo wenu na macho yenu, ambayo ninyi mnafanya ukahaba kwa kuyafuata,
sw.B: 'Kila mtakapokiona kishada hiki, kitawakumbusha amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili mzitende na msitangetange kufuata moyo wenu wenyewe na macho yenu wenyewe, mkiyafuata kwa ukosefu wa uaminifu,
sw.R: 'Mtakapokitazama kishada, mtazikumbuka amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuzitii. Hamtafuata tu chochote mioyo yenu inachotaka na macho yenu yanachoona. Kufuata hayo ni kama kutokuwa mwaminifu katika ndoa.

vi.L: 'Và đó sẽ là cái tua cho các ngươi, và các ngươi sẽ nhìn nó và nhớ lại tất cả các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và làm theo, và các ngươi sẽ không đi lang thang theo lòng mình và theo mắt mình, là những điều các ngươi theo đó mà gian dâm,
vi.B: 'Mỗi khi các ngươi thấy cái tua này, nó sẽ nhắc các ngươi nhớ mọi điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để các ngươi làm theo, và không đi lang thang theo lòng mình và mắt mình, chạy theo chúng mà bất trung,
vi.R: 'Khi nhìn cái tua, các ngươi sẽ nhớ tất cả các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và vâng giữ. Các ngươi sẽ không chạy theo bất cứ điều gì lòng mình muốn và mắt mình thấy. Chạy theo những điều ấy giống như không chung thủy trong hôn nhân.

ko.L: '그리고 그것이 너희에게 술이 될 것이니, 너희는 그것을 보고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 기억하여 그것들을 행하고, 너희가 음행하며 따르는 너희 마음과 너희 눈을 따라 두루 다니지 말라.
ko.B: '너희는 이 술을 볼 때마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 기억하고 그것을 지켜라. 너희 마음과 너희 눈이 끄는 대로 따라다니며 신실하지 못한 길로 가지 말라.
ko.R: '너희는 그 술을 볼 때마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 명령을 기억하고 지켜라. 너희 마음이 원하는 대로, 너희 눈에 보기 좋은 대로 따라가지 말라. 그것을 따르는 것은 남편이나 아내를 배신하는 것과 같다.

pt.L: 'E isso será para vocês uma borla, e vocês a verão e se lembrarão de todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e os cumprirão, e não andarão atrás do coração de vocês e atrás dos olhos de vocês, atrás dos quais vocês se prostituem,
pt.B: 'Sempre que virem esta borla, ela fará vocês se lembrarem de todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para que os cumpram e não andem atrás do próprio coração e dos próprios olhos, seguindo-os em infidelidade,
pt.R: 'Quando olharem para a borla, vocês vão se lembrar de todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e vão obedecer a eles. Vocês não vão simplesmente seguir o que o coração de vocês deseja e o que os olhos de vocês veem. Seguir essas coisas é como ser infiel no casamento.

am.L: “ዘርፍ ይሆንላችኋል፤ ታዩታላችሁ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ታስባላችሁ፤ ታደርጓቸዋላችሁም፤ ተከትላችኋቸው ዝሙት የምትፈጽሙባቸውን ልባችሁንና ዓይናችሁን ተከትላችሁ አትዞሩም፤
am.B: “ይህን ዘርፍ ባያችሁ ቁጥር {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ታስታውሳላችሁ፤ ይህም ትእዛዛቱን እንድትፈጽሙ፣ ታማኝነትን አጥታችሁ የገዛ ልባችሁንና የገዛ ዓይናችሁን ተከትላችሁ እንዳትቅበዘበዙ ነው፤
am.R: “ዘርፉን ስትመለከቱ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ታስታውሳላችሁ፤ ትታዘዟቸዋላችሁም። ልባችሁ የሚመኘውንና ዓይናችሁ የሚያየውን ሁሉ ዝም ብላችሁ አትከተሉም። እነርሱን መከተል በትዳር ውስጥ ታማኝ አለመሆን ነው።

hi.L: 'और वह तुम्हारे लिए झब्बा होगा, और तुम उसे देखो और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सब आज्ञाओं को स्मरण करो और उन्हें मानो, और अपने मन के और अपनी आँखों के पीछे न भटको, जिनके पीछे तुम व्यभिचार करते हो,
hi.B: 'जब भी तुम यह झब्बा देखोगे, तो तुम्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सब आज्ञाएँ याद आएँगी, ताकि तुम उनका पालन करो और अपने ही मन और अपनी ही आँखों के पीछे भटककर विश्वासघात न करो,
hi.R: 'जब तुम झब्बे को देखोगे, तो तुम्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की सब आज्ञाएँ याद आएँगी और तुम उनका पालन करोगे। तुम वह सब नहीं करोगे जो तुम्हारा मन चाहे और तुम्हारी आँखें देखें। ऐसा करना वैसा ही है जैसे कोई अपने विवाह में विश्वासघात करे।

ru.L: “И будет это у вас кистью, и будете смотреть на неё, и вспоминать все заповеди {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, и исполнять их, и не будете ходить вслед сердца вашего и вслед глаз ваших, за которыми вы блудите,
ru.B: “Когда будете видеть эту кисть, она будет напоминать вам о всех заповедях {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, чтобы вы исполняли их и не бродили вслед своего сердца и своих глаз, неверно идя за ними,
ru.R: “Когда вы будете смотреть на кисть, вы вспомните все заповеди {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и будете их исполнять. Вы не будете просто следовать за тем, чего хочет ваше сердце и что видят ваши глаза. Идти за ними — это как изменять в браке.

ja.L: 『それはあなたがたにとって房となる。あなたがたはそれを見て、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のすべての戒めを思い起こし、それらを行う。あなたがたは、自分の心と自分の目の後を追って探り回ってはならない。あなたがたはそれらを慕って淫行しているのである。
ja.B: 『この房を見るたびに、あなたがたは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のすべての戒めを思い起こし、それを行うようになる。自分の心や自分の目の欲するままにさまよい、それらを追って不誠実になることのないためである。
ja.R: 『房を見ると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のすべての命令を思い出し、それに従うようになる。自分の心がほしがるものや、目に見えるものに、ただついて行ってはいけない。それらについて行くのは、結婚の相手を裏切るようなことである。

uk.L: “І буде вам китиця, і будете дивитися на неї, і згадаєте всі заповіді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і виконаєте їх, і не будете блукати за своїм серцем і за своїми очима, за якими ви блудодієте,
uk.B: “Щоразу, коли побачите цю китицю, вона нагадає вам усі заповіді {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, щоб ви виконували їх і не блукали за власним серцем і власними очима, ідучи за ними в невірності,
uk.R: “Коли дивитиметеся на китицю, ви згадаєте всі накази {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і виконуватимете їх. Ви не підете за всім, чого прагне ваше серце і що бачать ваші очі. Іти за ними — це як зраджувати в подружжі.

decisions.choice: go about: the word used of the spies
decisions.reason: The verb means to go about exploring or searching out. It is the word used for the spies who went to scout the land (13:2, 16-17; 14:34). Israel had followed what the spies saw rather than what the LORD said; the tassel is to keep them from following their own eyes.

decisions.choice: after your heart and after your eyes: your own desires and what attracts you
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought and will, and the eyes the way desire is drawn to things. To go after them is to be led by one's own wishes instead of God's commands.

decisions.choice: prostituting: unfaithfulness to God
decisions.reason: Israel's turning from the LORD is often pictured as sexual unfaithfulness (Exodus 34:15-16; Judges 2:17). The noun from the same verb is used of the people's unfaithfulness in 14:33.

decisions.choice: it shall be a tassel for you: the tassel with its blue cord
decisions.reason: "It" is the tassel the LORD has just described; seeing it is meant to bring the commands to mind. The sentence runs on into verse 40.

decisions.choice: like being unfaithful in a marriage
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture behind the word instead of reproducing it. Balanced says "in unfaithfulness"; Literal keeps "prostitute yourselves".

decisions.choice: "gian dâm" (L); "bất trung" (B); "không chung thủy trong hôn nhân" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of prostitution, Balanced says it is unfaithfulness to God (meaning decision), and Readable explains the comparison, as the English Readable does; the same choice as 14:33.

decisions.choice: "đi lang thang" for go about
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the scouts (meaning decision); Vietnamese cannot keep the echo of "do thám" without losing the sense of roaming after one's desires.

decisions.choice: "두루 다니다" (L)
decisions.reason: The same verb as the scouts' "spy out" (meaning decision); Literal uses the "두루 다니다" that the scouts' report in 13:32 and 14:7 also uses, so the echo is heard.

decisions.choice: "음행하며" (L); "신실하지 못한 길" (B); "배신하는 것과 같다" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 14:33: unfaithfulness to God pictured as prostitution (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture, Balanced says what it means, and Readable compares it to unfaithfulness in marriage, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: andarão atrás de (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is the "espiar" of chapters 13-14 (m1). Portuguese cannot say "espiar atrás do coração", so Literal says "andar atrás de", as the English Literal says "go about after", and the link to the spies is left to the meaning note.

decisions.choice: "ዝሙት የምትፈጽሙባቸውን" (after which you commit whoredom) at Literal
decisions.reason: As at 14:33, Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, unfaithfulness to God.

decisions.choice: "व्यभिचार करते हो" (L), "विश्वासघात" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of unfaithfulness in marriage, the Hebrew word for unfaithfulness to God (m3). Balanced says "विश्वासघात"; Readable explains the picture, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "блудите" (L); "неверно идя за ними" (B); "как изменять в браке" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures unfaithfulness to God as sexual unfaithfulness (m3). Literal keeps the picture with "блудить"; Balanced says unfaithfulness; Readable spells out the comparison, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: tur "探り回る" (L), "さまよう" (B); zanah "慕って淫行する" (L), "不誠実になる" (B), "結婚の相手を裏切るようなこと" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb used of the spies ("探る", meaning decision m1) and the image of prostitution as in Leviticus 20:5; B and R give the sense.

decisions.choice: "блудодієте" (L), "невірність" (B), "зраджувати в подружжі" (R)
decisions.reason: The image is unfaithfulness to God; Literal keeps the sexual word, Base names the unfaithfulness, and Readable spells out the marriage picture.

source.text: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: so that you will remember and do all my commandments, and you will be holy to your God.

en.L: so that you may remember and do all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments, and be holy to your God.
en.B: so that you remember and do all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments and are holy to your God.
en.R: So remember all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands and obey them. Then you will be holy, set apart for your God.

es.L: para que {{plural_you:se acuerden|os acordéis}} y {{plural_you:cumplan|cumpláis}} todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos, y {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} santos para {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios.
es.B: así {{plural_you:recordarán|recordaréis}} y {{plural_you:cumplirán|cumpliréis}} todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos, y {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} santos para {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:acuérdense|acordaos}} de todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandatos y {{plural_you:obedézcanlos|obedecedlos}}. Entonces {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} santos, apartados para {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios.

fr.L: afin que vous vous souveniez et que vous pratiquiez tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements, et que vous soyez saints pour votre Dieu.
fr.B: ainsi vous vous souviendrez de tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements, vous les mettrez en pratique et vous serez saints pour votre Dieu.
fr.R: Souvenez-vous donc de tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et obéissez-y. Alors vous serez saints, mis à part pour votre Dieu.

sw.L: ili mpate kukumbuka na kuzitenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} zote, nanyi mwe watakatifu kwa Mungu wenu.
sw.B: ili mzikumbuke na kuzitenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} zote, nanyi muwe watakatifu kwa Mungu wenu.
sw.R: Basi kumbukeni amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} zote na kuzitii. Ndipo mtakuwa watakatifu, mliotengwa kwa ajili ya Mungu wenu.

vi.L: để các ngươi nhớ lại và làm theo tất cả các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và được thánh cho Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.
vi.B: để các ngươi nhớ và làm theo mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và được thánh cho Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.
vi.R: Vậy hãy nhớ mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và vâng giữ. Khi ấy các ngươi sẽ được thánh, được biệt riêng cho Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.

ko.L: 그리하여 너희가 내 모든 계명을 기억하고 행하여, 너희 하나님께 거룩하게 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그리하여 너희는 내 모든 계명을 기억하고 지켜서, 너희 하나님께 거룩한 백성이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그러니 내 모든 명령을 기억하고 지켜라. 그러면 너희는 거룩한 백성, 곧 너희 하나님께 바쳐진 백성이 될 것이다.

pt.L: para que vocês se lembrem e cumpram todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos, e sejam santos para o Deus de vocês.
pt.B: para que vocês se lembrem de todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e os cumpram, e sejam santos para o Deus de vocês.
pt.R: Por isso, lembrem-se de todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e obedeçam a eles. Assim vocês serão santos, separados para o Deus de vocês.

am.L: ይህም ትእዛዛቴን ሁሉ እንድታስቡና እንድታደርጓቸው፣ ለአምላካችሁም ቅዱሳን እንድትሆኑ ነው።
am.B: ይህም ትእዛዛቴን ሁሉ እንድታስታውሱና እንድትፈጽሙ፣ ለአምላካችሁም ቅዱሳን እንድትሆኑ ነው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ትእዛዛቴን ሁሉ አስታውሱ፤ ታዘዟቸውም። ያን ጊዜ ቅዱሳን፣ ለአምላካችሁ የተለያችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።

hi.L: ताकि तुम स्मरण करो और मेरी सब आज्ञाओं को मानो, और अपने परमेश्वर के लिए पवित्र रहो।
hi.B: ताकि तुम मेरी सब आज्ञाएँ याद रखो और उनका पालन करो, और अपने परमेश्वर के लिए पवित्र रहो।
hi.R: इसलिए मेरी सब आज्ञाएँ याद रखो और उनका पालन करो। तब तुम पवित्र रहोगे, अपने परमेश्वर के लिए अलग किए हुए।

ru.L: чтобы вы помнили и исполняли все {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} заповеди и были святы вашему Богу.
ru.B: чтобы вы помнили и исполняли все {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} заповеди и были святы для вашего Бога.
ru.R: Поэтому помните все {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} заповеди и исполняйте их. Тогда вы будете святы, отделены для вашего Бога.

ja.L: [それは]あなたがたがわたしのすべての戒めを思い起こしてそれらを行い、あなたがたの神にとって聖なる者となるためである。
ja.B: こうして、あなたがたはわたしのすべての戒めを思い起こして行い、あなたがたの神にとって聖なる者となる。
ja.R: だから、わたしのすべての命令を思い出し、それに従いなさい。そうすれば、あなたたちは聖なる者、あなたたちの神のものとして取り分けられた者となる。

uk.L: щоб ви згадували і виконували всі {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} заповіді, і були святі для вашого Бога.
uk.B: щоб ви памʼятали й виконували всі {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} заповіді і були святі для свого Бога.
uk.R: Тож памʼятайте всі {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}} накази і виконуйте їх. Тоді ви будете святі, відокремлені для свого Бога.

decisions.choice: holy to your God: set apart for God and belonging to him
decisions.reason: To be holy is to belong to God and to share his character (Leviticus 11:44; 19:2). Here the whole people, not only the priests, are called to be holy by keeping his commands.

decisions.choice: my commandments: the LORD speaks of himself
decisions.reason: Verse 39 spoke of "the commandments of the LORD"; here the LORD calls them his own, and verse 41 names him.

decisions.choice: set apart for
decisions.reason: Readable adds "set apart for" to say what being holy to God means.

source.text: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: I [am] Yahweh your God, who brought you out from [the] land of Egypt to be for you as God; I [am] Yahweh your God.

en.L: I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.'"
en.B: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.'"
en.R: I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. I brought you out of the land of Egypt so that I could be your God. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.'"

es.L: Yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, que {{plural_you:los|os}} saqué de la tierra de Egipto para ser {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios”».
es.B: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, que {{plural_you:los|os}} saqué de la tierra de Egipto para ser {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios”».
es.R: Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios. Yo {{plural_you:los|os}} saqué de la tierra de Egipto para ser {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios”».

fr.L: Je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, qui vous ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte pour être votre Dieu ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.” »
fr.B: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, qui vous ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte pour être votre Dieu. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.” »
fr.R: Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. Je vous ai fait sortir du pays d’Égypte pour être votre Dieu. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.” »

sw.L: Mimi [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri ili niwe Mungu wenu; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.'"
sw.B: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, niliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri ili niwe Mungu wenu. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.'"
sw.R: Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Niliwatoa katika nchi ya Misri ili niwe Mungu wenu. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.'"

vi.L: Ta [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, Đấng đã đem các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập để làm Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.'"
vi.B: Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, Đấng đã đem các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập để làm Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.'"
vi.R: Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi. Ta đã đem các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.'"

ko.L: 나는 너희를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내어 너희 하나님이 되려고 한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.'"
ko.B: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다. 내가 너희 하나님이 되려고 너희를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 냈다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.'"
ko.R: 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다. 내가 너희의 하나님이 되려고 너희를 이집트 땅에서 데리고 나왔다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.'"

pt.L: Eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que tirei vocês da terra do Egito para ser o Deus de vocês; eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.'"
pt.B: Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que tirei vocês da terra do Egito para ser o Deus de vocês. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.'"
pt.R: Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês. Eu tirei vocês da terra do Egito para ser o Deus de vocês. Eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês.'"

am.L: አምላክ እሆናችሁ ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]፤ እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነኝ]።”»
am.B: አምላካችሁ እሆን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ። እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።”»
am.R: እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ። አምላካችሁ እንድሆን ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣኋችሁ። እኔ አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነኝ።”»

hi.L: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ], जो तुम्हें मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया, कि तुम्हारा परमेश्वर ठहरूँ; मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर [हूँ]।'"
hi.B: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ, जो तुम्हें मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया, ताकि तुम्हारा परमेश्वर ठहरूँ। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ।'"
hi.R: मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ। मैं तुम्हें मिस्र देश से निकाल लाया, ताकि मैं तुम्हारा परमेश्वर बनूँ। मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} तुम्हारा परमेश्वर हूँ।'"

ru.L: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог ваш, который вывел вас из земли Египта, чтобы быть вам Богом; {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, Бог ваш.”»
ru.B: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог, который вывел вас из земли Египта, чтобы быть вашим Богом. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.”»
ru.R: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог. Я вывел вас из земли Египта, чтобы быть вашим Богом. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, ваш Бог.”»

ja.L: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、あなたがたの神であって、あなたがたの神となるために、あなたがたをエジプトの地から導き出した者である。わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、あなたがたの神である。』」
ja.B: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、あなたがたの神である。あなたがたの神となるために、あなたがたをエジプトの地から導き出した。わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、あなたがたの神である。』」
ja.R: わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、あなたたちの神である。わたしは、あなたたちの神となるために、あなたたちをエジプトの地から連れ出した。わたしは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、あなたたちの神である。』」

uk.L: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, що вивів вас із землі Єгипту, щоб бути вам Богом; Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.”»
uk.B: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог, що вивів вас із землі Єгипту, щоб бути вашим Богом. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.”»
uk.R: Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог. Я вивів вас із землі Єгипту, щоб бути вашим Богом. Я — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ваш Бог.”»

decisions.choice: who brought you out of Egypt to be your God: the ground of the commands
decisions.reason: The LORD's rescue of Israel from Egypt is the reason they are to obey him; he freed them so that they would belong to him as their God (Exodus 6:7; 20:2; Leviticus 11:45).

decisions.choice: I am the LORD your God, repeated: a closing seal
decisions.reason: The words open and close the verse, framing the law and the chapter with the LORD's own name.
